### /Users/atul/develop/SIF-Guard/sif-guard/app/core/config.py
```python
import os
from typing import Optional
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict

class Settings(BaseSettings):
    PROJECT_NAME: str = "SIF-Guard"
    API_V1_STR: str = "/api/v1"
    ENVIRONMENT: str = "development"
    LOG_LEVEL: str = "INFO"
    SECRET_KEY: str = "super-secret-key-change-in-production"

    # Database
    DATABASE_URL: str = "sqlite:///./sif_guard.db"

    # NLP & Embeddings
    EMBEDDING_MODEL: str = "BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5"
    MODEL_DIR: str = "app/ml/models"
    LSR_THRESHOLD: float = 0.65
    SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD: float = 0.70
    BATCH_SIZE: int = 32

    # SIF XGBoost Classifier Settings
    SIF_CLASSIFIER_MODE: str = "xgboost"
    SIF_MODEL_PATH: str = "app/ml/models/sif/xgboost_model.json"
    SIF_PREPROCESSOR_PATH: str = "app/ml/models/sif/preprocessor.joblib"
    SIF_HIGH_THRESHOLD: float = 0.70
    SIF_UNCERTAIN_THRESHOLD: float = 0.40

    # OCR Settings
    OCR_PROVIDER: str = "tesseract"
    OCR_VERIFICATION_THRESHOLD: float = 0.85
    OCR_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB: float = 15.0

    # MLflow
    MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: str = "http://localhost:5000"

    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(
        env_file=".env",
        env_file_encoding="utf-8",
        extra="ignore"
    )

settings = Settings()
```

### /Users/atul/develop/SIF-Guard/sif-guard/Dockerfile
```dockerfile
FROM python:3.10-slim

WORKDIR /app

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    libpq-dev \
    git \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY pyproject.toml .

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir .

COPY . .

EXPOSE 8000

CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
```

### /Users/atul/develop/SIF-Guard/sif-guard/docker-compose.yml
```yaml
version: '3.8'

services:
  api:
    build: .
    container_name: sif_guard_api
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://sif_user:sif_password@postgres:5432/sif_guard_db
      - EMBEDDING_MODEL=BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5
      - SIF_MODEL_PATH=app/ml/models/sif_xgboost_v1.json
      - MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI=http://mlflow:5000
    depends_on:
      - postgres
    volumes:
      - .:/app

  postgres:
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg15
    container_name: sif_guard_postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: sif_user
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: sif_password
      POSTGRES_DB: sif_guard_db
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

  mlflow:
    image: ghcr.io/mlflow/mlflow:v2.5.0
    container_name: sif_guard_mlflow
    ports:
      - "5000:5000"
    command: mlflow server --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5000

volumes:
  postgres_data:
```

34:             if len(lines) == 1 or filename.endswith(".json"):
35:                 data = json.loads(contents)
36:                 if isinstance(data, dict):
37:                     for k in ["reports", "data", "records", "items", "incidents"]:
38:                         if k in data and isinstance(data[k], list):
39:                             data = data[k]
40:                             break
41:                 df = pd.DataFrame(data if isinstance(data, list) else [data])
42:             else:
43:                 data = [json.loads(line) for line in lines if line.strip()]
44:                 df = pd.DataFrame(data)
45:         elif filename.endswith((".txt", ".log")) or file.content_type == "text/plain":
46:             text_str = contents.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore").strip()
47:             if "," in text_str and ("description" in text_str.lower() or "narrative" in text_str.lower() or "report_text" in text_str.lower()):
48:                 try:
49:                     df = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(contents))
50:                 except Exception:
51:                     df = pd.DataFrame([{
52:                         "report_text": text_str,
53:                         "source_record_id": f"RAW-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6].upper()}",
54:                         "site": "Not specified"
55:                     }])
56:             else:
57:                 df = pd.DataFrame([{
58:                     "report_text": text_str,
59:                     "source_record_id": f"RAW-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6].upper()}",
60:                     "site": "Not specified"
61:                 }])
62:         elif filename.endswith((".pdf", ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".bmp", ".tiff")):
63:             from app.services.ocr.service import ocr_service
64:             ocr_res = ocr_service.extract(contents, file.filename)
65:             if not ocr_res.text or not ocr_res.text.strip():
66:                 raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="OCR engine could not extract readable text from document.")
67:             df = pd.DataFrame([{
68:                 "report_text": ocr_res.text.strip(),
69:                 "source_record_id": f"OCR-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6].upper()}",
70:                 "site": "Not specified"
71:             }])
72:         else:
73:             text_str = contents.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore").strip()
74:             if text_str:
75:                 df = pd.DataFrame([{
76:                     "report_text": text_str,
77:                     "source_record_id": f"RAW-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6].upper()}",
78:                     "site": "Not specified"
79:                 }])
80:             else:
81:                 raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Unsupported file format. Please upload CSV, XLSX, JSON, TXT, PDF, or Image.")
82:     except HTTPException:
83:         raise
84:     except Exception as e:
85:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Failed to parse uploaded file: {str(e)}")
86: 
87:     total_received = len(df)
88:     adapter = OILHSSEAdapter()
89: 
90:     try:
91:         valid_df, invalid_count = adapter.validate(df)
92:         reports = adapter.ingest(valid_df)

95: 
96:     from app.api.routes.analysis import run_single_report_analysis
97:

100:

110:             continue
111:         
112:         db.add(r)
113:         db.commit()
114:         db.refresh(r)
115:         imported_ids.append(r.id)
116: 
117:         # Run automated analysis pipeline on imported report

120:         except Exception:

124:

2: from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query

4: import numpy as np
5: from app.db.database import get_db
6: from app.db.models.knowledge import HSEKnowledge

9:

13: @router.get("/knowledge/search", response_model=KnowledgeSearchResponse)
14: def search_knowledge(
15:     q: str = Query(..., min_length=2),
16:     category: Optional[str] = None,
17:     limit: int = Query(5, ge=1, le=20),
18:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
19: ):
20:     query_vec = np.array(embedding_service.encode(q))
21:     norm_q = np.linalg.norm(query_vec)
22: 
23:     items_query = db.query(HSEKnowledge)
24:     if category:
25:         items_query = items_query.filter(HSEKnowledge.category == category)
26:     
27:     items = items_query.all()
28:     
29:     results = []
30:     for item in items:
31:         emb = item.embedding or embedding_service.encode(item.content)
32:         item_vec = np.array(emb)
33:         norm_item = np.linalg.norm(item_vec)
34: 
35:         sim = np.dot(query_vec, item_vec) / (norm_q * norm_item) if norm_q > 0 and norm_item > 0 else 0.0
36:         
37:         results.append(KnowledgeItemSchema(
38:             id=item.id,
39:             source=item.source,
40:             title=item.title,
41:             content=item.content,
42:             category=item.category,
43:             similarity_score=round(float(sim), 4)
44:         ))
45: 
46:     results.sort(key=lambda x: x.similarity_score or 0.0, reverse=True)
47:     
48:     return KnowledgeSearchResponse(
49:         query=q,
50:         results=results[:limit]
51:     )

11: router = APIRouter()

14: @router.get("/review/queue", response_model=List[SafetyReportRead])
15: def get_review_queue(
16:     limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100),
17:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
18: ):
19:     # Queue consists of reports marked UNCERTAIN or with low confidence
20:     return db.query(SafetyReport).filter(
21:         (SafetyReport.sif_potential == "UNCERTAIN") | (SafetyReport.sif_confidence < 0.70)
22:     ).limit(limit).all()
23: 
24: 
25: @router.post("/review/{report_id}", response_model=ReviewRead)
26: def submit_review(
27:     report_id: str,
28:     review: ReviewCreate,
29:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
30: ):
31:     report = db.query(SafetyReport).filter(SafetyReport.id == report_id).first()
32:     if not report:
33:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Safety report '{report_id}' not found")
34: 
35:     # Update report with reviewed label
36:     report.sif_potential = review.label
37:     report.sif_confidence = review.confidence
38: 
39:     label_obj = SIFLabel(
40:         id=f"lbl_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
41:         report_id=report_id,
42:         label=review.label,
43:         confidence=review.confidence,
44:         source="expert_review",
45:         reviewer=review.reviewer,
46:         comments=review.comments
47:     )
48:     db.add(label_obj)
49:     db.commit()
50:     db.refresh(label_obj)
51: 
52:     return label_obj

10: async def extract_document_ocr(file: UploadFile = File(...)):
11:     """
12:     Extracts text from uploaded Image (PNG, JPG, JPEG) or PDF document using OCR quality gates.
13:     Returns structured text, confidence score, source type, and verification flag.
14:     """
15:     if not file or not file.filename:
16:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="No file provided in request.")
17: 
18:     filename = file.filename.lower()
19:     allowed_extensions = (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".pdf")
20:     if not filename.endswith(allowed_extensions):
21:         raise HTTPException(
22:             status_code=400,
23:             detail=f"Unsupported file format '{file.filename}'. Allowed extensions: PNG, JPG, JPEG, PDF."
24:         )
25: 
26:     contents = await file.read()
27:     if not contents or len(contents) == 0:
28:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Uploaded file is empty (0 bytes).")
29: 
30:     # Validate max file size
31:     max_bytes = int(settings.OCR_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB * 1024 * 1024)
32:     if len(contents) > max_bytes:
33:         raise HTTPException(
34:             status_code=400,
35:             detail=f"File size exceeds maximum threshold of {settings.OCR_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB}MB."
36:         )
37: 
38:     try:
39:         result = ocr_service.extract(contents, file.filename)
40:         return result
41:     except Exception as e:
42:         raise HTTPException(
43:             status_code=500,
44:             detail=f"OCR processing failed for '{file.filename}': {str(e)}"
45:         )

54: class SIFClassifier:
55:     """
56:     Production Trained XGBoost SIF Potential Classifier.
57:     Loads preprocessor and XGBoost model once at initialization.
58:     """
59: 
60:     def __init__(
61:         self,
62:         model_path: Optional[str] = None,
63:         preprocessor_path: Optional[str] = None,
64:         mode: Optional[str] = None,
65:     ):
66:         self.mode = mode or settings.SIF_CLASSIFIER_MODE
67: 
68:         base_dir = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "../.."))
69:         raw_mpath = model_path or settings.SIF_MODEL_PATH
70:         raw_ppath = preprocessor_path or settings.SIF_PREPROCESSOR_PATH
71: 
72:         self.model_path = raw_mpath if os.path.isabs(raw_mpath) else os.path.abspath(os.path.join(base_dir, "..", raw_mpath))
73:         self.preprocessor_path = raw_ppath if os.path.isabs(raw_ppath) else os.path.abspath(os.path.join(base_dir, "..", raw_ppath))
74: 
75:         self.model: Optional[xgb.Booster] = None
76:         self.preprocessor = None
77:         self.explainer = None
78:         self.feature_names: List[str] = []
79:         self.heuristic_fallback = HeuristicSIFClassifier()
80:         self.is_loaded = False
81: 
82:         self._load_artifacts()
83: 
84:     def _load_artifacts(self):
85:         if self.mode == "heuristic":
86:             logger.info("SIFClassifier explicitly configured for 'heuristic' mode.")
87:             return
88: 
89:         if not HAS_XGB:
90:             logger.error("XGBoost library not installed in environment.")
91:             return
92: 
93:         if not os.path.exists(self.model_path) or not os.path.exists(self.preprocessor_path):
94:             logger.warning(
95:                 f"XGBoost model or preprocessor artifact missing. Path: {self.model_path}, {self.preprocessor_path}"
96:             )
97:             return
98: 
99:         try:
100:             # Load preprocessor
101:             self.preprocessor = joblib.load(self.preprocessor_path)
102: 
103:             # Extract feature names from OneHotEncoder transformer
104:             if hasattr(self.preprocessor, "get_feature_names_out"):
105:                 self.feature_names = list(self.preprocessor.get_feature_names_out())
106: 
107:             # Load Booster
108:             self.model = xgb.Booster()
109:             self.model.load_model(self.model_path)
110: 
111:             # Initialize SHAP explainer if available
112:             if HAS_SHAP and self.model is not None:
113:                 try:
114:                     self.explainer = shap.TreeExplainer(self.model)
115:                 except Exception as ex:
116:                     logger.warning(f"Could not initialize SHAP TreeExplainer: {ex}")
117:                     self.explainer = None
118: 
119:             self.is_loaded = True
120:             logger.info(f"Loaded trained XGBoost model from {self.model_path}")
121:         except Exception as e:
122:             logger.error(f"Failed to load XGBoost artifacts: {e}")
123:             self.model = None
124:             self.preprocessor = None
125:             self.is_loaded = False
126: 
127:     def _explain_prediction(
128:         self,
129:         feature_record: Dict[str, str],
130:         transformed_row: np.ndarray,
131:         prob: float
132:     ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
133:         top_factors = []
134: 
135:         if self.explainer is not None:
136:             try:
137:                 shap_values = self.explainer.shap_values(transformed_row)
138:                 if isinstance(shap_values, list):
139:                     vals = shap_values[1][0] if len(shap_values) > 1 else shap_values[0][0]
140:                 elif shap_values.ndim == 2:
141:                     vals = shap_values[0]
142:                 else:
143:                     vals = shap_values
144: 
145:                 paired = []
146:                 for idx, fname in enumerate(self.feature_names):
147:                     impact = float(vals[idx])
148:                     if abs(impact) > 0.01:
149:                         parts = fname.replace("cat__", "").split("_", 1)
150:                         field_name = parts[0] if len(parts) > 0 else fname
151:                         val_str = feature_record.get(field_name, "present")
152:                         if val_str != "unknown":
153:                             paired.append({
154:                                 "feature": field_name,
155:                                 "value": val_str,
156:                                 "impact": round(impact, 4)
157:                             })
158: 
159:                 paired = sorted(paired, key=lambda x: abs(x["impact"]), reverse=True)
160:                 seen = set()
161:                 for item in paired:
162:                     if item["feature"] not in seen:
163:                         seen.add(item["feature"])
164:                         top_factors.append(item)
165:                     if len(top_factors) >= 3:
166:                         break
167:             except Exception as e:
168:                 logger.warning(f"SHAP explanation generation error: {e}")
169: 
170:         if not top_factors:
171:             for k in ["exposure", "barrier_failure", "hazard", "activity", "energy_source"]:
172:                 val = feature_record.get(k)
173:                 if val and val != "unknown":
174:                     top_factors.append({
175:                         "feature": k,
176:                         "value": val,
177:                         "impact": round(0.25 if prob >= 0.50 else -0.25, 4)
178:                     })
179:                 if len(top_factors) >= 3:
180:                     break
181: 
182:         return top_factors
183: 
184:     def predict(
185:         self,
186:         text: str,
187:         extraction: ExtractionSchema,
188:         raw_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
189:     ) -> SIFResultSchema:
190:         if self.mode == "heuristic" or not self.is_loaded or self.model is None or self.preprocessor is None:
191:             if self.mode == "xgboost" and not self.is_loaded:
192:                 logger.error("XGBoost mode requested but model artifacts not loaded. Falling back cleanly.")
193:             return self.heuristic_fallback.predict(text, extraction, raw_data)
194: 
195:         # 1. Convert ExtractionSchema to feature record
196:         feat_record = extraction_to_feature_record(extraction)
197: 
198:         # 2. DataFrame and OneHotEncoder transformation
199:         df_feat = pd.DataFrame([feat_record])[SIF_FEATURE_COLUMNS]
200:         transformed_vec = self.preprocessor.transform(df_feat)
201: 
202:         # 3. XGBoost Inference using predict_proba()
203:         dmatrix = xgb.DMatrix(transformed_vec)
204:         preds = self.model.predict(dmatrix)
205:         prob = float(preds[0])
206: 
207:         # 4. Domain rule evaluation guardrail
208:         rule_label, rule_conf, rule_risk_factors = weak_rules_engine.evaluate(text, extraction, raw_data)
209:         if rule_label == "SIF_POTENTIAL":
210:             prob = max(prob, 0.85)
211:         elif rule_label == "NON_SIF":
212:             prob = min(prob, 0.15)
213: 
214:         # 5. Threshold Policy
215:         high_thresh = settings.SIF_HIGH_THRESHOLD
216:         unc_thresh = settings.SIF_UNCERTAIN_THRESHOLD
217: 
218:         if prob >= high_thresh:
219:             classification = "SIF_POTENTIAL"
220:             confidence = round(max(prob, rule_conf), 4)
221:         elif prob < unc_thresh:
222:             classification = "NON_SIF"
223:             confidence = round(1.0 - prob, 4)
224:         else:
225:             classification = "UNCERTAIN"
226:             confidence = 0.50
227: 
228:         risk_factors = rule_risk_factors
229:         if not risk_factors:
230:             if classification == "SIF_POTENTIAL":
231:                 risk_factors = [f"High XGBoost model probability ({prob:.2%}) from structured safety attributes"]
232:             elif classification == "NON_SIF":
233:                 risk_factors = [f"Low XGBoost model probability ({prob:.2%}) - effective barriers verified"]
234:             else:
235:                 risk_factors = ["Borderline risk score requiring expert review"]
236: 
237:         # 6. SHAP Explainability
238:         top_factors = self._explain_prediction(feat_record, transformed_vec, prob)
239: 
240:         return SIFResultSchema(
241:             classification=classification,
242:             score=round(prob, 4),
243:             confidence=confidence,
244:             risk_factors=risk_factors,
245:             model_type="xgboost",
246:             model_version="1.0.0",
247:             top_factors=top_factors
248:         )

273:     def _extract_barrier_and_failure(self, t_lower: str) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str]]:
274:         sorted_rules = sorted(self.barrier_rules, key=lambda r: r.priority, reverse=True)
275: 
276:         failed_matches: List[Tuple[BarrierRule, int]] = []
277:         recognition_matches: List[BarrierRule] = []
278: 
279:         for rule in sorted_rules:
280:             # Check exclusions
281:             if any(re.search(ex, t_lower) for ex in rule.exclude_context):
282:                 continue
283: 
284:             rec_match = any(re.search(p, t_lower) for p in rule.recognition_patterns)
285:             fail_match_pattern = next((p for p in rule.failure_patterns if re.search(p, t_lower)), None)
286: 
287:             if fail_match_pattern and (rec_match or any(k in fail_match_pattern for k in ["without", "no ", "missing", "bypassed", "not ", "underneath"])):
288:                 match_obj = re.search(fail_match_pattern, t_lower)
289:                 start_pos = match_obj.start() if match_obj else 0
290:                 failed_matches.append((rule, start_pos))
291:             elif rec_match:
292:                 recognition_matches.append(rule)
293: 
294:         if failed_matches:
295:             best_rule, _ = failed_matches[0]
296:             return best_rule.barrier_category, best_rule.failure_message
297: 
298:         if recognition_matches:
299:             best_rule = recognition_matches[0]
300:             return best_rule.barrier_category, None
301: 
302:         return None, None
303: 
304:     def extract(self, text: str, report_metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> ExtractionSchema:
305:         if not text:
306:             return ExtractionSchema()
307: 
308:         t_lower = text.lower()
309: 
310:         # 1. Activity / Task
311:         activity = None
312:         if report_metadata and report_metadata.get("task_assigned"):
313:             activity = str(report_metadata["task_assigned"])
314:         elif "excavation" in t_lower or "trench" in t_lower:
315:             activity = "excavation work"
316:         elif "vehicle" in t_lower and ("pedestrian" in t_lower or "operating zone" in t_lower or "traffic" in t_lower):
317:             activity = "vehicle / pedestrian interaction"

37:         "keywords": ["hot work", "welding", "cutting", "grinding", "spark", "flammable", "ignition", "permit to work", "ptw"]
38:     },

43:         "keywords": ["lifting", "crane", "rigging", "hoist", "suspended load", "rigging equipment", "slings"]
44:     },
45:     {
46:         "code": "BYPASS_SAFETY_CONTROLS",

48:         "description": "Obtain authorization before overriding or disabling safety controls or safety critical equipment.",
49:         "keywords": ["bypass", "interlock", "safety control", "override", "disable", "safety valve", "alarm"]
50:     },

55:         "keywords": ["driving", "vehicle", "seatbelt", "speeding", "rollover", "driver", "transport", "truck"]
56:     },

61:         "keywords": ["water", "flotation device", "pfd", "barge", "offshore", "drowning", "lifejacket"]
62:     }
63: ]

65: 
66: class LSRMatcher:
67: 
68:     def __init__(self):
69:         self.rules = IOGP_LSR_DEFINITIONS
70:         self.rule_embeddings = {}
71: 
72:     def _get_rule_embedding(self, rule: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[float]:
73:         code = rule["code"]
74:         if code not in self.rule_embeddings:
75:             text = f"{rule['name']}: {rule['description']} Keywords: {', '.join(rule['keywords'])}"
76:             self.rule_embeddings[code] = embedding_service.encode(text)
77:         return self.rule_embeddings[code]
78: 
79:     def map_report(self, text: str, threshold: float = None) -> List[LSRMatchSchema]:
80:         if not text:
81:             return []
82: 
83:         threshold = threshold or settings.LSR_THRESHOLD
84:         t_lower = text.lower()
85:         report_emb = np.array(embedding_service.encode(text))
86: 
87:         matches = []
88:         for rule in self.rules:
89:             rule_emb = np.array(self._get_rule_embedding(rule))
90:             
91:             # Cosine similarity
92:             dot = np.dot(report_emb, rule_emb)
93:             norm_a = np.linalg.norm(report_emb)
94:             norm_b = np.linalg.norm(rule_emb)
95:             sim = dot / (norm_a * norm_b) if norm_a > 0 and norm_b > 0 else 0.0
96: 
97:             # Keyword boosting
98:             kw_match_count = sum(1 for kw in rule["keywords"] if kw in t_lower)
99:             boost = kw_match_count * 0.12
100:             final_score = float(np.clip(sim + boost, 0.0, 1.0))
101: 
102:             if final_score >= threshold:
103:                 confidence = float(np.clip(final_score * 0.95, 0.5, 0.99))
104:                 matches.append(LSRMatchSchema(
105:                     rule_code=rule["code"],
106:                     rule_name=rule["name"],
107:                     score=round(final_score, 4),
108:                     confidence=round(confidence, 4)
109:                 ))
110: 
111:         # Sort descending by score
112:         matches.sort(key=lambda x: x.score, reverse=True)
113:         return matches
114: 
115: 
116: lsr_matcher = LSRMatcher()

1: import os
2: import hashlib
3: from typing import List, Dict, Union, Optional
4: import numpy as np
5: from app.core.config import settings
6: from app.core.logging import logger
7: 
8: try:
9:     from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
10:     HAS_ST = True
11: except ImportError:
12:     HAS_ST = False
13: 
14: 
15: class EmbeddingService:
16:     _instance = None
17: 
18:     def __new__(cls, model_name: str = None):
19:         if cls._instance is None:
20:             cls._instance = super(EmbeddingService, cls).__new__(cls)
21:             cls._instance.model_name = model_name or settings.EMBEDDING_MODEL
22:             cls._instance._model = None
23:             cls._instance.cache = {}
24:         return cls._instance
25: 
26:     @property
27:     def model(self):
28:         if self._model is None and HAS_ST:
29:             logger.info(f"Loading embedding model: {self.model_name}")
30:             try:
31:                 self._model = SentenceTransformer(self.model_name)
32:             except Exception as e:
33:                 logger.warning(f"Failed to load HuggingFace model {self.model_name}, falling back to all-MiniLM-L6-v2: {e}")
34:                 try:
35:                     self._model = SentenceTransformer("all-MiniLM-L6-v2")
36:                 except Exception as ex:
37:                     logger.error(f"Fallback model failed: {ex}")
38:                     self._model = None
39:         return self._model
40: 
41:     def _hash_text(self, text: str) -> str:
42:         return hashlib.md5(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
43: 
44:     def encode(self, text: str) -> List[float]:
45:         if not text:
46:             return [0.0] * 768
47: 
48:         h = self._hash_text(text)
49:         if h in self.cache:
50:             return self.cache[h]
51: 
52:         if self.model is not None:
53:             vec = self.model.encode(text, convert_to_numpy=True).tolist()
54:         else:
55:             # Deterministic mock fallback vector of size 768 based on hash for testing environments
56:             rng = np.random.RandomState(int(h[:8], 16))
57:             vec = rng.randn(768).astype(float).tolist()
58: 
59:         self.cache[h] = vec
60:         return vec
61: 
62:     def encode_batch(self, texts: List[str]) -> List[List[float]]:
63:         if not texts:
64:             return []
65: 
66:         uncached_indices = []
67:         uncached_texts = []
68:         results = [None] * len(texts)
69: 
70:         for idx, text in enumerate(texts):
71:             h = self._hash_text(text)
72:             if h in self.cache:
73:                 results[idx] = self.cache[h]
74:             else:
75:                 uncached_indices.append(idx)
76:                 uncached_texts.append(text)
77: 
78:         if uncached_texts:
79:             if self.model is not None:
80:                 encoded = self.model.encode(uncached_texts, batch_size=settings.BATCH_SIZE, convert_to_numpy=True)
81:                 for idx, text, vec in zip(uncached_indices, uncached_texts, encoded):
82:                     vec_list = vec.tolist()
83:                     h = self._hash_text(text)
84:                     self.cache[h] = vec_list
85:                     results[idx] = vec_list
86:             else:
87:                 for idx, text in zip(uncached_indices, uncached_texts):
88:                     vec = self.encode(text)
89:                     results[idx] = vec
90: 
91:         return results
92:

46:         scored_candidates = []
47: 
48:         for cand in candidates:
49:             cand_text_norm = (cand.report_text or "").strip().lower()
50:             if cand_text_norm in seen_texts:
51:                 continue
52:             seen_texts.add(cand_text_norm)
53: 
54:             cand_emb = cand.embedding
55:             if not cand_emb:
56:                 cand_emb = embedding_service.encode(cand.report_text)
57:             
58:             cand_vec = np.array(cand_emb)
59:             norm_cand = np.linalg.norm(cand_vec)
60: 
61:             sim = np.dot(target_vec, cand_vec) / (norm_target * norm_cand) if norm_target > 0 and norm_cand > 0 else 0.0
62:             if sim < settings.SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD:
63:                 continue
64:             
65:             scored_candidates.append({
66:                 "id": cand.id,
67:                 "source_record_id": cand.source_record_id,
68:                 "report_text": cand.report_text[:200] + ("..." if len(cand.report_text) > 200 else ""),
69:                 "activity": cand.activity,
70:                 "hazard": cand.hazard,
71:                 "barrier_failure": cand.barrier_failure,
72:                 "sif_potential": cand.sif_potential,
73:                 "similarity": round(float(sim), 4)
74:             })
75: 
76:         scored_candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x["similarity"], reverse=True)
77:         return scored_candidates[:limit]
78:

19: class PrecursorClusteringService:
20: 
21:     def cluster_reports(self, db: Session, min_cluster_size: int = 3) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
22:         reports = db.query(SafetyReport).all()
23:         if len(reports) < 2:
24:             logger.warning(f"Not enough reports ({len(reports)}) to perform clustering.")
25:             return []
26: 
27:         # 1. Batch encode any un-embedded reports and persist to DB
28:         unencoded = [r for r in reports if not r.embedding]
29:         if unencoded:
30:             logger.info(f"Batch encoding {len(unencoded)} un-embedded reports for clustering...")
31:             unencoded_texts = [r.report_text for r in unencoded]
32:             batch_vecs = embedding_service.encode_batch(unencoded_texts)
33:             for r, vec in zip(unencoded, batch_vecs):
34:                 r.embedding = vec
35:             db.commit()
36: 
37:         embeddings = []
38:         valid_reports = []
39:         for r in reports:
40:             if r.embedding:
41:                 embeddings.append(r.embedding)
42:                 valid_reports.append(r)
43: 
44:         if len(valid_reports) < 2:
45:             return []
46: 
47:         X = np.array(embeddings, dtype=np.float32)
48:         # L2 normalization for cosine similarity compatibility with Euclidean distance
49:         norms = np.linalg.norm(X, axis=1, keepdims=True)
50:         norms[norms == 0] = 1e-10
51:         X_norm = X / norms
52: 
53:         # 2. Perform HDBSCAN or KMeans clustering
54:         labels = None
55:         eff_min_size = max(2, min(min_cluster_size, len(valid_reports) // 2))
56: 
57:         if HAS_HDBSCAN and len(valid_reports) >= 4:
58:             try:
59:                 clusterer = hdbscan.HDBSCAN(
60:                     min_cluster_size=eff_min_size,
61:                     min_samples=1,
62:                     metric='euclidean',
63:                     cluster_selection_epsilon=0.35
64:                 )
65:                 raw_labels = clusterer.fit_predict(X_norm)
66:                 non_noise = set(l for l in raw_labels if l != -1)
67:                 
68:                 if len(non_noise) > 0:
69:                     labels = np.array(raw_labels, copy=True)
70:                     # Reassign noise (-1) points to closest cluster centroid if similarity is sufficiently high
71:                     centroids = {}
72:                     for cid in non_noise:
73:                         centroids[cid] = np.mean(X_norm[labels == cid], axis=0)
74: 
75:                     for idx, label in enumerate(labels):
76:                         if label == -1:
77:                             best_cid = -1
78:                             best_sim = -1.0
79:                             vec = X_norm[idx]
80:                             for cid, c_vec in centroids.items():
81:                                 sim = float(np.dot(vec, c_vec))
82:                                 if sim > best_sim:
83:                                     best_sim = sim
84:                                     best_cid = cid
85:                             if best_sim >= 0.60:
86:                                 labels[idx] = best_cid
87:                 else:
88:                     logger.info("HDBSCAN resulted in 0 non-noise clusters. Falling back to KMeans.")
89:             except Exception as e:
90:                 logger.warning(f"HDBSCAN clustering execution failed ({e}), falling back to KMeans.")
91: 
92:         if labels is None or len(set(l for l in labels if l != -1)) == 0:
93:             k = max(2, min(6, len(valid_reports) // 2))
94:             kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10)
95:             labels = kmeans.fit_predict(X_norm)
96: 
97:         # 3. Clear old cluster definitions
98:         db.query(PrecursorCluster).delete()
99: 
100:         cluster_groups: Dict[int, List[SafetyReport]] = {}
101:         for label, report in zip(labels, valid_reports):
102:             cid = int(label)
103:             if cid not in cluster_groups:
104:                 cluster_groups[cid] = []
105:             cluster_groups[cid].append(report)
106: 
107:         created_clusters = []
108:         for cid, group in cluster_groups.items():
109:             cid_int = int(cid)
110:             if cid_int == -1: # Unassigned noise in HDBSCAN
111:                 continue
112: 
113:             total_count = int(len(group))
114:             sif_count = int(sum(1 for r in group if r.sif_potential == "SIF_POTENTIAL"))
115:             sif_density = float(round(sif_count / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0.0, 4))
116: 
117:             activities = [str(r.activity) for r in group if r.activity]
118:             hazards = [str(r.hazard) for r in group if r.hazard]
119:             barriers = [str(r.barrier) for r in group if r.barrier]
120:             failures = [str(r.barrier_failure) for r in group if r.barrier_failure]
121:             lsrs = []
122:             for r in group:
123:                 if r.life_saving_rules and isinstance(r.life_saving_rules, list):
124:                     for item in r.life_saving_rules:
125:                         if isinstance(item, dict) and "rule_name" in item:
126:                             lsrs.append(str(item["rule_name"]))
127:                         elif isinstance(item, str):
128:                             lsrs.append(item)
129: 
130:             dom_activity = str(Counter(activities).most_common(1)[0][0]) if activities else "General Activity"
131:             dom_hazard = str(Counter(hazards).most_common(1)[0][0]) if hazards else "Unspecified Hazard"
132:             dom_barrier = str(Counter(barriers).most_common(1)[0][0]) if barriers else "Safety Barrier"
133:             dom_failure = str(Counter(failures).most_common(1)[0][0]) if failures else "Barrier Defect"
134:             dom_lsr = str(Counter(lsrs).most_common(1)[0][0]) if lsrs else "Life-Saving Rule"
135: 
136:             cluster_name = f"{dom_activity} incidents involving {dom_hazard}"
137:             desc = f"Recurring precursor pattern around {dom_failure} during {dom_activity}."
138: 
139:             cluster_obj = PrecursorCluster(
140:                 id=f"cluster_{cid_int}",
141:                 cluster_id=cid_int,
142:                 name=cluster_name,
143:                 description=desc,
144:                 report_count=total_count,
145:                 sif_precursor_count=sif_count,
146:                 sif_density=sif_density,
147:                 dominant_activity=dom_activity,
148:                 dominant_hazard=dom_hazard,
149:                 dominant_barrier=dom_barrier,
150:                 dominant_barrier_failure=dom_failure,
151:                 dominant_lsr=dom_lsr,
152:                 representative_report_ids=[str(r.id) for r in group[:5]]
153:             )
154:             db.add(cluster_obj)
155:             created_clusters.append({
156:                 "id": f"cluster_{cid_int}",

158:                 "name": cluster_name,
159:                 "description": desc,

11:         query = db.query(SafetyReport)

13:             query = query.filter(SafetyReport.data_origin != "synthetic")
14:         reports = query.all()

19:         period_data = defaultdict(lambda: {"total": 0, "sif": 0})
20: 
21:         for r in reports:
22:             dt = r.event_date or r.created_at
23:             if grouping == "quarter":
24:                 quarter = (dt.month - 1) // 3 + 1
25:                 period_str = f"{dt.year}-Q{quarter}"
26:             else:
27:                 period_str = dt.strftime("%Y-%m")
28:             
29:             period_data[period_str]["total"] += 1
30:             if r.sif_potential == "SIF_POTENTIAL":
31:                 period_data[period_str]["sif"] += 1
32: 
33:         sorted_periods = sorted(period_data.keys())
34:         trend_results = []
35:         prev_sif_count = None
36: 
37:         for period in sorted_periods:
38:             total = period_data[period]["total"]
39:             sif_count = period_data[period]["sif"]
40:             density = round(sif_count / total if total > 0 else 0.0, 4)
41: 
42:             pct_change = 0.0
43:             trend_dir = "STABLE"
44:             if prev_sif_count is not None:
45:                 if prev_sif_count > 0:
46:                     pct_change = round(((sif_count - prev_sif_count) / prev_sif_count) * 100.0, 2)
47:                 elif sif_count > 0:
48:                     pct_change = 100.0
49:                 
50:                 if pct_change > 5.0:
51:                     trend_dir = "INCREASE"
52:                 elif pct_change < -5.0:
53:                     trend_dir = "DECREASE"
54: 
55:             prev_sif_count = sif_count
56:             trend_results.append(TrendData(
57:                 period=period,
58:                 total_reports=total,
59:                 sif_precursors=sif_count,
60:                 sif_density=density,
61:                 percentage_change=pct_change,
62:                 trend=trend_dir
63:             ))
64: 
65:         return trend_results

1: import re
2: import unicodedata
3: from typing import Dict, List, Optional
4: 
5: 
6: DEFAULT_TERMINOLOGY = {
7:     "LOTO": "Lockout Tagout",
8:     "PTW": "Permit to Work",
9:     "PPE": "Personal Protective Equipment",
10:     "H2S": "Hydrogen Sulfide",
11:     "SIMOPS": "Simultaneous Operations",
12:     "JSA": "Job Safety Analysis",
13:     "RA": "Risk Assessment",
14:     "LEL": "Lower Explosive Limit",
15:     "CO": "Carbon Monoxide",
16:     "SCBA": "Self Contained Breathing Apparatus",
17:     "MOC": "Management of Change",
18: }
19: 
20: 
21: class TextCleaner:
22: 
23:     def __init__(self, terminology: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None):
24:         self.terminology = terminology or DEFAULT_TERMINOLOGY
25: 
26:     def normalize_text(self, text: str) -> str:
27:         if not text:
28:             return ""
29:         
30:         # Unicode normalization
31:         text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text)
32:         
33:         # Clean malformed/non-printable chars except standard whitespace
34:         text = re.sub(r'[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]', '', text)
35:         
36:         # Whitespace normalization
37:         text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip()
38:         
39:         return text
40: 
41:     def expand_terminology(self, text: str) -> str:
42:         """
43:         Expands acronyms in text while preserving safety terms.
44:         E.g., 'Worker did not apply LOTO' -> 'Worker did not apply Lockout Tagout (LOTO)'
45:         """
46:         if not text:
47:             return ""
48:         
49:         expanded = text
50:         for term, expansion in self.terminology.items():
51:             # Match whole word
52:             pattern = re.compile(rf'\b{re.escape(term)}\b', re.IGNORECASE)
53:             # Expand only if expansion not already present
54:             if term.lower() in expanded.lower() and expansion.lower() not in expanded.lower():
55:                 expanded = pattern.sub(f"{term} ({expansion})", expanded)
56:                 
57:         return expanded
58: 
59:     def preprocess(self, text: str) -> str:
60:         cleaned = self.normalize_text(text)
61:         return self.expand_terminology(cleaned)

217: class FacilityService:
218:     def __init__(self):
219:         self._demo_incidents: List[ZoneIncident] = []
220:         self._zone_lookup = {z["id"]: z for z in FACILITY_ZONES_CONFIG}
221: 
222:     def infer_zone_id(
223:         self,
224:         report_text: str,
225:         activity: Optional[str] = None,
226:         hazard: Optional[str] = None,
227:         equipment: Optional[str] = None,
228:         barrier_failure: Optional[str] = None,
229:         raw_location: Optional[str] = None,
230:         raw_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
231:         deterministic_seed: Optional[str] = None
232:     ) -> str:
233:         """
234:         Infers the facility zone for a given safety observation report.
235:         Deterministic & Explainable: Structured location/zone fields take precedence,
236:         followed by weighted keyword matching across narrative and extracted dimensions.
237:         """
238:         # 1. Check structured raw data or location
239:         if raw_data and isinstance(raw_data, dict):
240:             structured_zone = raw_data.get("zone_id") or raw_data.get("facility_zone")
241:             if structured_zone and structured_zone in self._zone_lookup:
242:                 return structured_zone
243: 
244:         if raw_location:
245:             loc_lower = raw_location.lower()
246:             for z in FACILITY_ZONES_CONFIG:
247:                 if z["id"] in loc_lower or z["name"].lower() in loc_lower:
248:                     return z["id"]
249: 
250:         # 2. Build aggregated search context with weights
251:         text_corpus = f"{report_text or ''} {activity or ''} {activity or ''} {hazard or ''} {equipment or ''} {equipment or ''} {barrier_failure or ''}".lower()
252: 
253:         scores: Dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
254:         for zone in FACILITY_ZONES_CONFIG:
255:             zone_id = zone["id"]
256:             for kw in zone["keywords"]:
257:                 if kw in text_corpus:
258:                     # Give higher weight to longer exact phrases
259:                     weight = 3 if " " in kw else 1
260:                     scores[zone_id] += weight
261: 
262:         if scores:
263:             best_zone, best_score = max(scores.items(), key=lambda item: item[1])
264:             if best_score > 0:
265:                 return best_zone
266: 
267:         # 3. Deterministic hash fallback
268:         if deterministic_seed:
269:             hash_val = sum(ord(c) for c in deterministic_seed)
270:             return FACILITY_ZONES_CONFIG[hash_val % len(FACILITY_ZONES_CONFIG)]["id"]
271: 
272:         return "wellhead-area"
273: 
274:     def calculate_zone_risk(
275:         self,
276:         zone_id: str,
277:         incidents: List[ZoneIncident]
278:     ) -> Tuple[int, str, str, int, List[RiskFactor], List[str]]:
279:         """
280:         Deterministic, explainable risk aggregation model.
281:         Returns: (risk_score, risk_level, trend, trend_delta, risk_factors, recommended_actions)
282:         """
283:         zone_cfg = self._zone_lookup.get(zone_id, FACILITY_ZONES_CONFIG[0])
284:         
285:         if not incidents:
286:             # Baseline quiet operational status
287:             return (
288:                 18,
289:                 "LOW",
290:                 "STABLE",
291:                 0,
292:                 [
293:                     RiskFactor(
294:                         title="Baseline Facility Status",
295:                         impact="Nominal",
296:                         description="No active critical precursors recorded in current operational window.",
297:                         category="baseline"
298:                     )
299:                 ],
300:                 zone_cfg["default_actions"]
301:             )
302: 
303:         total_count = len(incidents)
304:         sif_count = sum(1 for i in incidents if i.sif_potential == "SIF_POTENTIAL" or i.severity == "CRITICAL")
305:         uncertain_count = sum(1 for i in incidents if i.sif_potential == "UNCERTAIN" or i.severity == "HIGH")
306:         barrier_failures = sum(1 for i in incidents if i.barrier_failure)
307:         high_conf_count = sum(1 for i in incidents if (i.sif_score or 0) >= 0.80 or (i.sif_confidence or 0) >= 0.80)
308: 
309:         # Raw Score Calculation
310:         raw_score = (
311:             sif_count * 28 +
312:             uncertain_count * 12 +
313:             barrier_failures * 14 +
314:             high_conf_count * 10 +
315:             min(20, total_count * 3)
316:         )
317: 
318:         # Normalization to 0-100 scale
319:         if total_count == 1:
320:             scaled = min(98, max(20, raw_score))
321:         else:
322:             scaled = min(98, max(15, int(raw_score * 1.15 / (total_count ** 0.35))))
323: 
324:         # Determine Risk Level
325:         if scaled >= 81:
326:             risk_level = "CRITICAL"
327:         elif scaled >= 61:
328:             risk_level = "HIGH"
329:         elif scaled >= 31:
330:             risk_level = "MODERATE"
331:         else:
332:             risk_level = "LOW"
333: 
334:         # Calculate Trend
335:         half = max(1, total_count // 2)
336:         recent_subset = incidents[:half]
337:         older_subset = incidents[half:]
338: 
339:         recent_sif = sum(1 for i in recent_subset if i.severity in ["CRITICAL", "HIGH"])
340:         older_sif = sum(1 for i in older_subset if i.severity in ["CRITICAL", "HIGH"])
341: 
342:         trend_delta = (recent_sif - older_sif) * 12
343:         if trend_delta > 0:
344:             trend = "INCREASE"
345:         elif trend_delta < 0:
346:             trend = "DECREASE"
347:         else:
348:             trend = "STABLE"
349: 
350:         # Dynamic Risk Factors Explainability
351:         factors: List[RiskFactor] = []
352:         if sif_count > 0:
353:             factors.append(
354:                 RiskFactor(
355:                     title=f"{sif_count} High-Potential SIF Precursors",
356:                     impact=f"+{sif_count * 28} pts",
357:                     description=f"{sif_count} reports flagged with verified fatality / severe harm potential.",
358:                     category="sif_precursor"
359:                 )
360:             )
361: 
362:         if barrier_failures > 0:
363:             factors.append(
364:                 RiskFactor(
365:                     title=f"{barrier_failures} Active Barrier Breaches",
366:                     impact=f"+{barrier_failures * 14} pts",
367:                     description="Safety barriers, LOTO, gas testing, or machine guarding failed or bypassed.",
368:                     category="barrier_breach"
369:                 )
370:             )
371: 
372:         if high_conf_count > 0:
373:             factors.append(
374:                 RiskFactor(
375:                     title=f"{high_conf_count} High-Confidence Energy Exposures",
376:                     impact=f"+{high_conf_count * 10} pts",
377:                     description="AI NLP model identified extreme energy line-of-fire or pressure isolation failures.",
378:                     category="energy_exposure"
379:                 )
380:             )
381: 
382:         if trend == "INCREASE":
383:             factors.append(
384:                 RiskFactor(
385:                     title="Precursor Velocity Acceleration",
386:                     impact=f"+{trend_delta} pts",
387:                     description="Significant increase in near-miss frequency detected in recent shift telemetry.",
388:                     category="velocity"
389:                 )
390:             )
391: 
392:         if not factors:
393:             factors.append(
394:                 RiskFactor(
395:                     title="Routine Operational Exposure",
396:                     impact="+12 pts",
397:                     description="Minor observations and non-SIF maintenance activities recorded.",
398:                     category="baseline"
399:                 )
400:             )
401: 
402:         # Dynamic Recommended Safety Actions
403:         actions: List[str] = list(zone_cfg["default_actions"])
404:         
405:         # Add specific action based on barrier failures
406:         all_barriers = [i.barrier_failure for i in incidents if i.barrier_failure]
407:         if all_barriers:
408:             top_barrier = Counter(all_barriers).most_common(1)[0][0]
409:             actions.insert(0, f"Prioritize immediate site audit on: {top_barrier.capitalize()}.")
410: 
411:         return (scaled, risk_level, trend, trend_delta, factors, actions[:4])

413:     def get_facility_overview(self, db: Session) -> FacilityRiskSummary:
414:         """
415:         Builds complete digital twin facility risk model combining persistent safety reports
416:         with any active demo simulated events.
417:         """
418:         # Fetch reports from DB
419:         db_reports = db.query(SafetyReport).all()
420:         
421:         zone_incidents_map: Dict[str, List[ZoneIncident]] = defaultdict(list)
422:         all_timeline: List[ZoneIncident] = []

424:         # 1. Process DB reports into ZoneIncidents
425:         for r in db_reports:
426:             zone_id = self.infer_zone_id(
427:                 report_text=r.report_text,
428:                 activity=r.activity,
429:                 hazard=r.hazard,
430:                 equipment=r.equipment,

432:                 raw_location=r.location or r.site,
433:                 raw_data=r.raw_data,
434:                 deterministic_seed=r.id

450:             )

473:             all_timeline.append(incident_obj)

476:         for demo_inc in self._demo_incidents:

478:             all_timeline.insert(0, demo_inc)
479: 
480:         # 3. Build FacilityZone models for all 7 zones
481:         zones: List[FacilityZone] = []
482:         high_risk_zones_count = 0
483:         total_active_incidents = 0
484:         total_critical_incidents = 0
485:         zone_scores: List[int] = []
486: 
487:         for zone_cfg in FACILITY_ZONES_CONFIG:
488:             z_id = zone_cfg["id"]
489:             z_incidents = zone_incidents_map.get(z_id, [])
490:             
491:             # Dominant dimensions
492:             activities = [i.activity for i in z_incidents if i.activity]
493:             hazards = [i.hazard for i in z_incidents if i.hazard]
494:             barriers = [i.barrier_failure for i in z_incidents if i.barrier_failure]
495:             
496:             dominant_act = Counter(activities).most_common(1)[0][0] if activities else None
497:             dominant_haz = Counter(hazards).most_common(1)[0][0] if hazards else None
498:             dominant_barr = Counter(barriers).most_common(1)[0][0] if barriers else None
499: 
500:             # LSR dominant
501:             lsr_names = []
502:             for inc in z_incidents:
503:                 if inc.life_saving_rules and isinstance(inc.life_saving_rules, list):
504:                     for rule in inc.life_saving_rules:
505:                         r_name = rule.get("rule_name") if isinstance(rule, dict) else str(rule)
506:                         if r_name:
507:                             lsr_names.append(r_name)
508:             dominant_lsr = Counter(lsr_names).most_common(1)[0][0] if lsr_names else None
509: 
510:             # Calculate risk
511:             score, level, trend, trend_delta, factors, actions = self.calculate_zone_risk(z_id, z_incidents)
512:             
513:             crit_count = sum(1 for i in z_incidents if i.severity == "CRITICAL" or i.sif_potential == "SIF_POTENTIAL")
514:             active_count = len(z_incidents)
515: 
516:             if level in ["CRITICAL", "HIGH"]:
517:                 high_risk_zones_count += 1
518: 
519:             total_active_incidents += active_count
520:             total_critical_incidents += crit_count
521:             zone_scores.append(score)
522: 
523:             has_recent_incident = any(i.is_demo for i in z_incidents) or (active_count > 0)
524: 
525:             zone_model = FacilityZone(
526:                 id=z_id,
527:                 name=zone_cfg["name"],
528:                 code=zone_cfg["code"],
529:                 description=zone_cfg["description"],
530:                 risk_score=score,
531:                 risk_level=level,
532:                 total_incidents=len(z_incidents),
533:                 active_incidents=active_count,
534:                 critical_incidents=crit_count,
535:                 recent_incident_state=has_recent_incident,
536:                 risk_trend=trend,
537:                 risk_trend_delta=trend_delta,
538:                 risk_factors=factors,
539:                 dominant_hazard=dominant_haz,
540:                 dominant_activity=dominant_act,
541:                 dominant_barrier_failure=dominant_barr,
542:                 dominant_lsr=dominant_lsr,
543:                 recommended_actions=actions,
544:                 incidents=z_incidents,
545:                 svg_center=zone_cfg["svg_center"]
546:             )
547:             zones.append(zone_model)
548: 
549:         # Sort zones by risk score descending
550:         zones.sort(key=lambda z: z.risk_score, reverse=True)
551: 
552:         # Calculate Overall Facility Risk Score
553:         if zone_scores:
554:             # Weighted mix: 50% max zone risk + 50% average zone risk
555:             max_score = max(zone_scores)
556:             avg_score = sum(zone_scores) / len(zone_scores)
557:             overall_score = int(round(max_score * 0.55 + avg_score * 0.45))
558:         else:
559:             overall_score = 15
560: 
561:         if overall_score >= 81:
562:             overall_level = "CRITICAL"
563:         elif overall_score >= 61:
564:             overall_level = "HIGH"
565:         elif overall_score >= 31:
566:             overall_level = "MODERATE"
567:         else:
568:             overall_level = "LOW"
569: 
570:         return FacilityRiskSummary(

572:             risk_level=overall_level,
573:             total_incidents=len(all_timeline),
574:             active_incidents=total_active_incidents,
575:             critical_incidents=total_critical_incidents,
576:             high_risk_zones_count=high_risk_zones_count,
577:             zones=zones,
578:             recent_timeline=all_timeline[:30],
579:             last_updated=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
580:         )

592:     def simulate_demo_incident(
593:         self,
594:         db: Session,

596:     ) -> DemoSimulationResponse:
597:         """
598:         Executes end-to-end demo flow:
599:         1. Select/Construct incident text.

601:         3. Run explainable SIF classifier & weak supervision.
602:         4. Run IOGP Life-Saving Rules alignment.

606:         """
607:         scenario: Optional[DemoScenario] = None
608:         if request.scenario_id:
609:             for s in DEMO_SCENARIO_CATALOG:
610:                 if s.id == request.scenario_id:
611:                     scenario = s
612:                     break
613: 
614:         if scenario:
615:             text = scenario.simulated_text
616:             target_zone = scenario.zone_id
617:             title = scenario.title
618:             default_sev = scenario.severity
619:         else:
620:             text = request.custom_text or "Pressure surge and flammable vapor leak observed during maintenance operations."
621:             target_zone = request.zone_id or self.infer_zone_id(text)
622:             title = request.custom_title or "Simulated Field Safety Precursor"
623:             default_sev = request.severity or "CRITICAL"
624: 
625:         # 1. Run live NLP extraction
626:         extraction = extraction_service.extract(text)
627: 
628:         # 2. Run live SIF classification
629:         sif_res = sif_classifier.predict(text, extraction)
630: 
631:         # 3. Run live LSR matcher
632:         lsr_matches = lsr_matcher.map_report(text)
633:         lsr_payload = [m.model_dump() for m in lsr_matches]
634: 
635:         # 4. Determine final zone

637:             report_text=text,
638:             activity=extraction.activity,
639:             hazard=extraction.hazard,
640:             equipment=extraction.equipment,
641:             barrier_failure=extraction.barrier_failure
642:         )
643:         zone_name = self._zone_lookup.get(final_zone_id, {}).get("name", "Facility Zone")
644: 
645:         # 5. Create new ZoneIncident
646:         now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
647:         inc_id = f"demo_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
648: 
649:         sev = "CRITICAL" if sif_res.classification == "SIF_POTENTIAL" else (
650:             "HIGH" if sif_res.classification == "UNCERTAIN" else default_sev
651:         )
652: 
653:         new_incident = ZoneIncident(
654:             id=inc_id,
655:             source_record_id=f"SIM-{now.strftime('%H%M%S')}",
656:             report_text=text,
657:             report_summary=title,
658:             event_date=now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
659:             formatted_time=now.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
660:             severity=sev,
661:             sif_potential=sif_res.classification,
662:             sif_score=sif_res.score,
663:             sif_confidence=sif_res.confidence,
664:             activity=extraction.activity or "Simulated Operational Task",
665:             hazard=extraction.hazard or "Hazardous Energy Accumulation",
666:             barrier_failure=extraction.barrier_failure or "Primary Containment Defect",
667:             life_saving_rules=lsr_payload,
668:             zone_id=final_zone_id,
669:             zone_name=zone_name,
670:             is_demo=True
671:         )
672: 
673:         # Prepend to demo incidents list (in-memory)
674:         self._demo_incidents.insert(0, new_incident)
675: 
676:         # Cap demo incidents to recent 15 to avoid infinite growth
677:         if len(self._demo_incidents) > 15:
678:             self._demo_incidents = self._demo_incidents[:15]
679: 
680:         # 6. Recalculate facility summary
681:         updated_summary = self.get_facility_overview(db)
682: 
683:         return DemoSimulationResponse(
684:             success=True,
685:             message=f"Simulated incident successfully classified and mapped to {zone_name}.",
686:             incident=new_incident,
687:             affected_zone_id=final_zone_id,
688:             affected_zone_name=zone_name,
689:             updated_facility_summary=updated_summary
690:         )

35: class TesseractOCRProvider(BaseOCRProvider):
36:     """
37:     Open-source Tesseract OCR Provider implementation using pytesseract.
38:     """
39: 
40:     def extract_image(self, image_bytes: bytes, filename: str) -> OCRResultSchema:
41:         try:
42:             processed_img = preprocess_image_for_ocr(image_bytes)
43: 
44:             # Get detailed data with confidence and bounding boxes
45:             data = pytesseract.image_to_data(processed_img, output_type=pytesseract.Output.DICT)
46: 
47:             raw_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(processed_img)
48:             norm_text = normalize_ocr_text(raw_text)
49: 
50:             # Safely extract confidence values and tokens
51:             confidences = []
52:             tokens = []
53:             raw_text_items = data.get("text", [])
54:             raw_conf_items = data.get("conf", [])
55: 
56:             for i in range(len(raw_text_items)):
57:                 word = str(raw_text_items[i]).strip() if raw_text_items[i] else ""
58:                 raw_c = raw_conf_items[i] if i < len(raw_conf_items) else -1
59:                 try:
60:                     c_float = float(raw_c)
61:                 except (ValueError, TypeError):
62:                     c_float = -1.0
63: 
64:                 if word:
65:                     if c_float > 0:
66:                         confidences.append(c_float)
67:                         conf_score = round(c_float / 100.0, 2)
68:                     else:
69:                         conf_score = 0.0
70: 
71:                     tokens.append(
72:                         OCRTokenResult(
73:                             text=word,
74:                             confidence=conf_score,
75:                             bbox=OCRBoundingBox(
76:                                 x1=float(data["left"][i]),
77:                                 y1=float(data["top"][i]),
78:                                 x2=float(data["left"][i] + data["width"][i]),
79:                                 y2=float(data["top"][i] + data["height"][i]),
80:                             ),
81:                         )
82:                     )
83: 
84:             if confidences:
85:                 avg_conf = sum(confidences) / len(confidences) / 100.0
86:             elif norm_text:
87:                 avg_conf = 0.85
88:             else:
89:                 avg_conf = 0.0
90: 
91:             page_res = OCRPageResult(
92:                 page_number=1,
93:                 text=norm_text,
94:                 confidence=round(avg_conf, 4),
95:                 tokens=tokens,
96:             )
97: 
98:             requires_verification = avg_conf < settings.OCR_VERIFICATION_THRESHOLD
99: 
100:             return OCRResultSchema(
101:                 text=norm_text,
102:                 confidence=round(avg_conf, 4),
103:                 source_type="image",
104:                 pages=1,
105:                 requires_verification=requires_verification,
106:                 warnings=["Low OCR confidence - user verification recommended"] if requires_verification else [],
107:                 page_results=[page_res],
108:                 ocr_provider="tesseract",
109:             )
110:         except Exception as e:
111:             logger.error(f"Tesseract OCR image extraction error: {e}")
112:             # Graceful fallback text return if pytesseract binary is unavailable
113:             return OCRResultSchema(
114:                 text="",
115:                 confidence=0.0,
116:                 source_type="image",
117:                 pages=1,
118:                 requires_verification=True,
119:                 warnings=[f"OCR processing error: {str(e)}"],
120:                 ocr_provider="tesseract",
121:             )

123:     def extract_pdf(self, pdf_bytes: bytes, filename: str) -> OCRResultSchema:
124:         warnings = []
125: 
126:         # 1. Attempt Native PDF text extraction first (Fast Path)
127:         if HAS_PYPDF:
128:             try:
129:                 reader = pypdf.PdfReader(io.BytesIO(pdf_bytes))
130:                 num_pages = len(reader.pages)
131:                 extracted_pages = []
132:                 full_text_parts = []
133:                 has_native_text = False
134: 
135:                 for idx, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
136:                     p_text = page.extract_text() or ""
137:                     if len(p_text.strip()) > 5:
138:                         has_native_text = True
139:                         norm_p_text = normalize_ocr_text(p_text)
140:                         full_text_parts.append(norm_p_text)
141:                         extracted_pages.append(
142:                             OCRPageResult(
143:                                 page_number=idx + 1,
144:                                 text=norm_p_text,
145:                                 confidence=0.98,
146:                                 tokens=[]
147:                             )
148:                         )
149: 
150:                 full_text = "\n\n".join(full_text_parts)
151:                 if has_native_text and len(full_text.strip()) > 30:  # Meaningful native text obtained
152:                     return OCRResultSchema(
153:                         text=full_text,
154:                         confidence=0.98,
155:                         source_type="pdf",
156:                         pages=num_pages,
157:                         requires_verification=False,
158:                         warnings=[],
159:                         page_results=extracted_pages,
160:                         ocr_provider="pypdf_native",
161:                     )
162:                 else:
163:                     warnings.append("Native PDF text empty/insufficient. Processing embedded page images via OCR...")
164: 
165:                 # 2. Extract embedded images from PDF pages for OCR (No external Poppler dependency required!)
166:                 image_pages = []
167:                 image_text_parts = []
168:                 conf_list = []
169: 
170:                 for idx, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
171:                     page_img_texts = []
172:                     page_tokens = []
173:                     page_confs = []
174: 
175:                     if hasattr(page, "images") and page.images:
176:                         for img_obj in page.images:
177:                             try:
178:                                 img_data = img_obj.data
179:                                 img_res = self.extract_image(img_data, getattr(img_obj, "name", "page_img.png"))
180:                                 if img_res.text.strip():
181:                                     page_img_texts.append(img_res.text)
182:                                     page_confs.append(img_res.confidence)
183:                                     if img_res.page_results and img_res.page_results[0].tokens:
184:                                         page_tokens.extend(img_res.page_results[0].tokens)
185:                             except Exception as img_ex:
186:                                 logger.warning(f"OCR extraction failed for embedded image on page {idx+1}: {img_ex}")
187: 
188:                     if page_img_texts:
189:                         combined_page_text = "\n".join(page_img_texts)
190:                         image_text_parts.append(combined_page_text)
191:                         avg_p_conf = sum(page_confs) / len(page_confs) if page_confs else 0.85
192:                         conf_list.append(avg_p_conf)
193:                         image_pages.append(
194:                             OCRPageResult(
195:                                 page_number=idx + 1,
196:                                 text=combined_page_text,
197:                                 confidence=round(avg_p_conf, 4),
198:                                 tokens=page_tokens
199:                             )
200:                         )
201: 
202:                 if image_text_parts:
203:                     combined_full_text = "\n\n".join(image_text_parts)
204:                     if len(combined_full_text.strip()) > 10:
205:                         avg_conf = sum(conf_list) / len(conf_list) if conf_list else 0.85
206:                         requires_verification = avg_conf < settings.OCR_VERIFICATION_THRESHOLD
207:                         return OCRResultSchema(
208:                             text=combined_full_text,
209:                             confidence=round(avg_conf, 4),
210:                             source_type="pdf",
211:                             pages=num_pages,
212:                             requires_verification=requires_verification,
213:                             warnings=warnings,
214:                             page_results=image_pages,
215:                             ocr_provider="tesseract_pypdf_images",
216:                         )
217: 
218:             except Exception as ex:
219:                 logger.warning(f"pypdf extraction failed: {ex}. Attempting fallback...")
220:                 warnings.append(f"Native PDF parsing failed: {ex}.")
221:

- Backend: Python/FastAPI in `/Users/atul/develop/SIF-Guard/sif-guard/`
- Frontend: React/TypeScript in `/Users/atul/develop/SIF-Guard/sif-guard-frontend/`

- Config: `pydantic_settings.BaseSettings`, env from `.env`, defaults: SQLite, `BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5` embeddings, XGBoost SIF classifier, tesseract OCR, MLflow at localhost:5000
- SIF thresholds: HIGH=0.70, UNCERTAIN=0.40; LSR_THRESHOLD=0.65; SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD=0.70
- DB Models (10): SafetyReport, ReportAnalysis, LifeSavingRule, HSEKnowledge, CatastrophicMechanism, PrecursorCluster, SIFLabel, AnalysisJob, Terminology, ModelRegistry
- SafetyReport has ~50+ columns covering source, text, geo, industry, activity, hazard, barrier, severity, SIF classification, embeddings, relationships to ReportAnalysis and SIFLabel
- ReportAnalysis stores SIF classification/score/confidence, risk_factors, extraction, LSR, fingerprint as JSON, catastrophic_similarity_score
- Services architecture: extraction (rule-based barrier taxonomy), SIF classifier (XGBoost primary + heuristic fallback + weak rules), LSR matcher (IOGP 9 rules with keyword+embedding matching), embeddings (sentence-transformers singleton with cache), fingerprint, similarity (cosine on embeddings), clustering (HDBSCAN/KMeans), analytics, trends, preprocessing (text cleaning + acronym expansion), OCR, facility (digital twin)
- OILHSSEAdapter: ingestion adapter for OIL UA/UC/Near Miss/Incident datasets; validates narrative columns, normalizes to SafetyReport, detects `data_origin` (synthetic vs real)
- FacilityService: 7 standardized facility zones (Wellhead Area Z-01, Pump Station Z-02, etc.) with SVG centers, keywords, default actions; imports extraction_service, sif_classifier, lsr_matcher; supports demo scenarios and simulation
- WeakSupervisionRules: domain-specific heuristic rules evaluating precursor indicators; returns (suggested_label, confidence, risk_factors); includes proactive/low-risk detection, confined space, and other hazard-specific rules
- ML features: 11 categorical feature columns (activity, hazard, hazardous_substance, exposure, energy_source, equipment, human_factor, environmental_factor, barrier, barrier_failure, potential_consequence); `extraction_to_feature_record()` maps ExtractionSchema to feature dict with "unknown" defaults
- ML preprocessor: scikit-learn ColumnTransformer with OneHotEncoder (handle_unknown="ignore") on SIF_FEATURE_COLUMNS

71:     localStorage.setItem('sif_guard_theme', theme);
72:   }, [theme]);
73: 
74:   const handleNavigate = (tab: TabId) => {
75:     setActiveTab(tab);
76:     mainContentRef.current?.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
77:   };
78: 
79:   const toggleTheme = () => {
80:     setTheme((prev) => (prev === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'));
81:   };
82: 
83:   const toggleCollapse = () => {
84:     setIsCollapsed((prev) => !prev);
85:   };
86: 
87:   // Auto-collapse sidebar on smaller screens or high zoom
88:   useEffect(() => {
89:     const handleResize = () => {
90:       if (window.innerWidth < 1080) {
91:         setIsCollapsed(true);
92:       }
93:     };
94:     handleResize();
95:     window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
96:     return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
97:   }, []);
98: 
99:   // Global Keyboard Shortcuts (Tabs 1-8, '?' for shortcuts modal, 'Esc' to close modal)
100:   useEffect(() => {
101:     if (!user) return;
102: 
103:     const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
104:       const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
105:       const tag = target?.tagName?.toLowerCase();
106:       if (tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea') return;
107: 
108:       if (e.key === '?') {
109:         e.preventDefault();
110:         setShortcutsOpen((prev) => !prev);
111:       } else if (e.key === 'Escape' && shortcutsOpen) {
112:         setShortcutsOpen(false);
113:       } else if (!e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey) {
114:         const num = parseInt(e.key, 10);
115:         if (num >= 1 && num <= TAB_ORDER.length) {
116:           e.preventDefault();
117:           handleNavigate(TAB_ORDER[num - 1]);
118:         }
119:       }
120:     };
121: 
122:     window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
123:     return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
124:   }, [shortcutsOpen, user]);
125: 
126:   // Loading state: Do not display dashboard content while authentication is resolving
127:   if (loading) {
128:     return (
129:       <div
130:         style={{
131:           height: '100vh',
132:           width: '100vw',
133:           display: 'flex',
134:           flexDirection: 'column',
135:           alignItems: 'center',
136:           justifyContent: 'center',
137:           backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-primary, #080706)',
138:           color: 'var(--text-primary, #F5F1EA)',
139:           fontFamily: 'Inter, sans-serif',
140:         }}
141:       >
142:         <div
143:           style={{
144:             width: '56px',
145:             height: '56px',
146:             borderRadius: '14px',
147:             backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.12)',
148:             border: '1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.3)',
149:             display: 'flex',
150:             alignItems: 'center',
151:             justifyContent: 'center',
152:             marginBottom: '20px',
153:           }}
154:         >
155:           <ShieldAlert size={30} color="var(--primary, #FF7300)" />
156:         </div>
157:         <div
158:           style={{
159:             display: 'flex',
160:             alignItems: 'center',
161:             gap: '10px',
162:             color: 'var(--text-secondary, #A8A099)',
163:             fontSize: '0.9rem',
164:           }}
165:         >
166:           <Loader2 size={18} style={{ animation: 'spin 1s linear infinite' }} />
167:           <span>Verifying SIF-Guard session...</span>
168:         </div>
169:       </div>
170:     );
171:   }
172: 
173:   // Unauthenticated: Show Landing Page by default, or Auth Page when requested
174:   if (!user) {
175:     if (showAuth) {
176:       return (
177:         <Suspense fallback={<ModuleLoadingFallback />}>
178:           <AuthPage onBack={() => setShowAuth(false)} />
179:         </Suspense>
180:       );
181:     }
182:     return (
183:       <Suspense fallback={<ModuleLoadingFallback />}>
184:         <LandingPage
185:           onEnterPlatform={() => setShowAuth(true)}
186:           theme={theme}
187:           onToggleTheme={toggleTheme}
188:         />
189:       </Suspense>

192: 
193:   // Authenticated: Show full existing SIF-Guard Application
194:   return (

196:       <Header

199:         onOpenShortcuts={() => setShortcutsOpen(true)}
200:       />
201: 
202:       <div style={{ display: 'flex', flex: 1, minHeight: 0, overflow: 'hidden' }}>

204:           activeTab={activeTab}
205:           onTabChange={handleNavigate}

209:

212:             {activeTab === 'dashboard' && <DashboardPage onNavigate={handleNavigate} />}
213:             {activeTab === 'facility' && <FacilityTwinPage theme={theme} />}
214:             {activeTab === 'ingestion' && <IngestionPage onNavigate={handleNavigate} />}
215:             {activeTab === 'explorer' && <ReportsExplorerPage onNavigate={handleNavigate} />}
216:             {activeTab === 'clusters' && <PrecursorClustersPage onNavigate={handleNavigate} />}
