1: import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
2: import type { User, Session } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
3: import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
4: 
5: export interface UserProfile {
6:   id: string;
7:   full_name: string | null;
8: }
9: 
10: interface AuthContextType {
11:   user: User | null;
12:   session: Session | null;
13:   profile: UserProfile | null;
14:   loading: boolean;
15:   signIn: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<{ error: Error | null }>;
16:   signUp: (email: string, password: string, fullName: string) => Promise<{ error: Error | null; user: User | null }>;
17:   signOut: () => Promise<void>;
18: }
19: 
20: const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);
21: 
22: export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
23:   const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
24:   const [session, setSession] = useState<Session | null>(null);
25:   const [profile, setProfile] = useState<UserProfile | null>(null);
26:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
27: 
28:   const fetchProfile = async (userId: string) => {
29:     try {
30:       const { data, error } = await supabase
31:         .from('profiles')
32:         .select('id, full_name')
33:         .eq('id', userId)
34:         .maybeSingle();
35: 
36:       if (!error && data) {
37:         setProfile(data);
38:       } else {
39:         setProfile({ id: userId, full_name: null });
40:       }
41:     } catch (err) {
42:       console.error('[SIF-Guard Auth] Failed to fetch profile:', err);
43:       setProfile({ id: userId, full_name: null });
44:     }
45:   };
46: 
47:   useEffect(() => {
48:     let mounted = true;
49: 
50:     // 1. Initial session check
51:     supabase.auth.getSession().then(({ data: { session } }) => {
52:       if (!mounted) return;
53:       setSession(session);
54:       setUser(session?.user ?? null);
55:       if (session?.user) {
56:         fetchProfile(session.user.id);
57:       }
58:       setLoading(false);
59:     }).catch((err) => {
60:       console.error('[SIF-Guard Auth] Error fetching initial session:', err);
61:       if (mounted) setLoading(false);
62:     });
63: 
64:     // 2. Subscribe to auth state updates (login, logout, token refresh)
65:     const { data: { subscription } } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange(
66:       async (_event, currentSession) => {
67:         if (!mounted) return;
68:         setSession(currentSession);
69:         setUser(currentSession?.user ?? null);
70: 
71:         if (currentSession?.user) {
72:           await fetchProfile(currentSession.user.id);
73:         } else {
74:           setProfile(null);
75:         }
76: 
77:         setLoading(false);
78:       }
79:     );
80: 
81:     return () => {
82:       mounted = false;
83:       subscription.unsubscribe();
84:     };
85:   }, []);
86: 
87:   const signIn = async (email: string, password: string): Promise<{ error: Error | null }> => {
88:     try {
89:       const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
90:         email: email.trim(),
91:         password,
92:       });
93: 
94:       if (error) {
95:         return { error: new Error(error.message) };
96:       }
97: 
98:       setSession(data.session);
99:       setUser(data.user);
100:       if (data.user) {
101:         await fetchProfile(data.user.id);
102:       }
103: 
104:       return { error: null };
105:     } catch (err: any) {
106:       return { error: new Error(err?.message || 'A network error occurred during login') };
107:     }
108:   };
109: 
110:   const signUp = async (
111:     email: string,
112:     password: string,
113:     fullName: string
114:   ): Promise<{ error: Error | null; user: User | null }> => {
115:     try {
116:       const trimmedName = fullName.trim();
117:       const trimmedEmail = email.trim();
118: 
119:       const { data, error: signUpError } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
120:         email: trimmedEmail,
121:         password,
122:         options: {
123:           data: {
124:             full_name: trimmedName,
125:           },
126:         },
127:       });
128: 
129:       if (signUpError) {
130:         return { error: new Error(signUpError.message), user: null };
131:       }
132: 
133:       const createdUser = data.user;
134:

137:         const { error: profileError } = await supabase
138:           .from('profiles')
139:           .upsert({
140:             id: createdUser.id,
141:             full_name: trimmedName,
142:           });
143: 
144:         if (profileError) {
145:           console.warn('[SIF-Guard Auth] Notice: Profile table insertion returned:', profileError.message);
146:         } else {
147:           setProfile({ id: createdUser.id, full_name: trimmedName });
148:         }
149:       }
150: 
151:       return { error: null, user: createdUser };
152:     } catch (err: any) {
153:       return { error: new Error(err?.message || 'A network error occurred during signup'), user: null };
154:     }
155:   };
156: 
157:   const signOut = async (): Promise<void> => {
158:     try {
159:       await supabase.auth.signOut();
160:     } catch (err) {
161:       console.error('[SIF-Guard Auth] SignOut error:', err);
162:     } finally {
163:       setSession(null);
164:       setUser(null);
165:       setProfile(null);
166:     }
167:   };
168: 
169:   return (
170:     <AuthContext.Provider
171:       value={{
172:         user,
173:         session,
174:         profile,
175:         loading,
176:         signIn,
177:         signUp,
178:         signOut,
179:       }}
180:     >
181:       {children}
182:     </AuthContext.Provider>
183:   );
184: };
185: 
186: export const useAuth = (): AuthContextType => {
187:   const context = useContext(AuthContext);
188:   if (!context) {

1: import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
2: import Lenis from 'lenis';
3: 
4: interface SmoothScrollOptions {
5:   enabled?: boolean;
6: }
7: 
8: /**
9:  * Hook to provide butter-smooth, deliberate page scrolling via Lenis.
10:  * Features:
11:  * - Automatically respects `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
12:  * - Preserves native wheel zooming on Three.js canvases via `data-lenis-prevent`.
13:  * - Clean lifecycle management with requestAnimationFrame.
14:  */
15: export function useSmoothScroll({ enabled = true }: SmoothScrollOptions = {}) {
16:   const lenisRef = useRef<Lenis | null>(null);
17: 
18:   useEffect(() => {
19:     // Check user preference for reduced motion
20:     const prefersReducedMotion =
21:       typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
22:       window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
23: 
24:     if (!enabled || prefersReducedMotion) {
25:       return;
26:     }
27: 
28:     const lenis = new Lenis({
29:       duration: 1.15,
30:       easing: (t: number) => Math.min(1, 1.001 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t)), // Exponential easeOut
31:       orientation: 'vertical',
32:       gestureOrientation: 'vertical',
33:       smoothWheel: true,
34:       wheelMultiplier: 0.88,
35:       touchMultiplier: 1.5,
36:     });
37: 
38:     lenisRef.current = lenis;
39: 
40:     let rafId: number;
41:     const raf = (time: number) => {
42:       lenis.raf(time);
43:       rafId = requestAnimationFrame(raf);
44:     };
45: 
46:     rafId = requestAnimationFrame(raf);
47: 
48:     // Listen for changes to reduced motion preference
49:     const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
50:     const handleReducedMotionChange = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => {
51:       if (e.matches && lenisRef.current) {
52:         lenisRef.current.destroy();
53:         lenisRef.current = null;
54:         cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
55:       }
56:     };
57: 
58:     mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handleReducedMotionChange);
59: 
60:     return () => {
61:       mediaQuery.removeEventListener('change', handleReducedMotionChange);
62:       cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
63:       lenis.destroy();
64:       lenisRef.current = null;
65:     };
66:   }, [enabled]);
67: 
68:   return lenisRef;
69: }

## Important Details
- Project is "SIF-Guard": AI/NLP-powered Serious Injury & Fatality Precursor Intelligence Platform for Oil India Limited
- Backend: Python/FastAPI in `/Users/atul/develop/SIF-Guard/sif-guard/`
- Frontend: React/TypeScript in `/Users/atul/develop/SIF-Guard/sif-guard-frontend/`
- Database: SQLite (sif_guard.db), with Supabase env vars also present
- Backend uses SQLAlchemy ORM, declarative_base, SessionLocal pattern
- FastAPI app with lifespan that auto-creates tables and seeds IOGP Life-Saving Rule definitions
- API prefix from `settings.API_V1_STR` (`/api/v1`), CORS open to all origins
- Config: `pydantic_settings.BaseSettings`, env from `.env`, defaults: SQLite, `BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5` embeddings, XGBoost SIF classifier, tesseract OCR, MLflow at localhost:5000
- SIF thresholds: HIGH=0.70, UNCERTAIN=0.40; LSR_THRESHOLD=0.65; SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD=0.70
- DB Models (10): SafetyReport, ReportAnalysis, LifeSavingRule, HSEKnowledge, CatastrophicMechanism, PrecursorCluster, SIFLabel, AnalysisJob, Terminology, ModelRegistry
- SafetyReport has ~50+ columns; ReportAnalysis stores SIF classification/score/confidence, risk_factors, extraction, LSR, fingerprint as JSON
- Services architecture: extraction (rule-based barrier taxonomy), SIF classifier (XGBoost + heuristic fallback + weak rules), LSR matcher (IOGP 9 rules with keyword+embedding matching), embeddings (sentence-transformers singleton with cache), fingerprint, similarity (cosine on embeddings), clustering (HDBSCAN/KMeans), analytics, trends, preprocessing, OCR, facility (digital twin)
- OILHSSEAdapter: ingestion adapter for OIL UA/UC/Near Miss/Incident datasets
- FacilityService: 7 standardized facility zones with SVG centers, keywords, default actions; supports demo scenarios and simulation
- WeakSupervisionRules: domain-specific heuristic rules for SIF precursor detection
- ML features: 11 categorical feature columns; sklearn ColumnTransformer with OneHotEncoder
- OCR service: `OCRService` wraps `BaseOCRProvider` (abstract), default `TesseractOCRProvider`; handles image (PNG/JPG/JPEG/BMP/TIFF) and PDF; preprocessing includes grayscale conversion + contrast enhancement; text normalization preserves HSE acronyms (LOTO, H2S, LEL, PTW, etc.); Tesseract binary auto-detected across macOS/Linux; PDF support via pypdf + pdf2image
- OCR schemas: `OCRResultSchema` (text, confidence, source_type, pages, requires_verification, warnings, page_results, ocr_provider), `OCRPageResult`, `OCRTokenResult`, `OCRBoundingBox`
- Frontend App.tsx: lazy-loaded pages (Dashboard, FacilityTwin, Ingestion, ReportsExplorer, PrecursorClusters, Analytics, KnowledgeLSR, ReviewQueue, DesignSystem, Landing, Auth); uses `AuthProvider`, `Header`, `Navigation`, `KeyboardShortcutsModal`
- Frontend auth: Supabase-based AuthContext with user/session/profile state, signIn/signUp/signOut
- Frontend state: Zustand `useFilterStore` with DashboardFilters (dateRange, locations, activities, hazards, barriers, sifClassification, lifeSavingRules, patterns, searchQuery)
- Frontend types: `api.ts` (ExtractionSchema, SIFResultSchema, LSRMatchSchema, FingerprintSchema, SimilarReport, AnalysisResponse, SafetyReportRead, DashboardSummary, BarrierRanking, PrecursorCluster, TrendData), `facility.ts` (RiskLevel, RiskTrend, RiskFactor, ZoneIncident, FacilityZone, FacilityRiskSummary)
- Frontend utils: `riskUtils.ts` (RISK_COLORS, getRiskLevelFromScore, getRiskColor), `activityFormatter.ts` (ActivityFeedItem generation from reports), `insightFormatter.ts` (deterministic SafetyInsight generation from backend data, non-causal phrasing)
- Frontend hooks: `useSmoothScroll.ts` (Lenis-based smooth scrolling, respects prefers-reduced-motion)
- Supabase client: `lib/supabase.ts` using `VITE_SUPABASE_URL` and `VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`

234:           setIsScrolled(window.scrollY > 30);
235:           ticking = false;
236:         });
237:         ticking = true;
238:       }
239:     };
240:     window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true });
241:     return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
242:   }, []);

37:   const [source, setSource] = useState<ReportInputSource>('pdf');
38:   const [pastedText, setPastedText] = useState<string>('');
39:   const [isCameraModalOpen, setIsCameraModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
40: 
41:   // OCR Workflow Steps: 1: Capture, 2: Processing, 3: Verify, 4: Analyzed
42:   const [step, setStep] = useState<number>(1);
43:   const [ocrResult, setOcrResult] = useState<OCRExtractResponse | null>(null);
44:   const [_selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
45:   const [editableText, setEditableText] = useState<string>('');
46:   const [rawOcrText, setRawOcrText] = useState<string>('');
47:   const [showRawOcrToggle, setShowRawOcrToggle] = useState<boolean>(false);
48: 
49:   // Analysis state
50:   const [analyzing, setAnalyzing] = useState<boolean>(false);
51:   const [analysisStage, setAnalysisStage] = useState<string>('Analyzing safety report...');
52:   const [analyzedReport, setAnalyzedReport] = useState<SafetyReportRead | null>(null);
53:   const [analysisData, setAnalysisData] = useState<AnalysisResponse | null>(null);
54:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
55:   const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState<boolean>(false);
56: 
57:   const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
58:   const cameraInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
59: 
60:   const isOcrSource = source === 'pdf' || source === 'image' || source === 'camera';
61: 
62:   // Handle document/image file upload
63:   const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
64:     if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
65:       const file = e.target.files[0];
66:       setSelectedFile(file);
67:       setError(null);
68:       
69:       const fileType = file.type.toLowerCase();
70:       const fileName = file.name.toLowerCase();
71: 
72:       if (fileName.endsWith('.pdf')) {
73:         setSource('pdf');
74:         processOCR(file);
75:       } else if (fileType.includes('image') || fileName.endsWith('.png') || fileName.endsWith('.jpg') || fileName.endsWith('.jpeg')) {
76:         setSource('image');
77:         processOCR(file);
78:       } else if (fileName.endsWith('.csv') || fileName.endsWith('.json')) {
79:         setSource('structured');
80:         processStructuredFile(file);
81:       } else {
82:         setSource('pdf');
83:         processOCR(file);
84:       }
85:     }
86:   };
87: 
88:   const processOCR = async (file: File) => {
89:     setStep(2);
90:     setError(null);
91: 
92:     try {
93:       const res = await extractDocumentOCR(file);
94:       setOcrResult(res);
95:       const textToUse = res.text || res.extracted_text || '';
96:       setEditableText(textToUse);
97:       setRawOcrText(textToUse);
98:       setStep(3);
99:     } catch (err: any) {
100:       setError(err.message || 'OCR document processing failed');
101:       setStep(1);
102:     }
103:   };
104: 
105:   const processStructuredFile = async (file: File) => {
106:     setStep(2);
107:     setError(null);
108:     try {
109:       const text = await file.text();
110:       setEditableText(text);
111:       setRawOcrText(text);
112:       setOcrResult(null); // No OCR ran for structured text
113:       setStep(3);
114:     } catch (err: any) {
115:       setError(err.message || 'Failed to read structured file');
116:       setStep(1);
117:     }
118:   };
119: 
120:   // Handle Manual Human Narrative Paste (OCR MUST BE SKIPPED)
121:   const handlePasteSubmit = () => {
122:     if (!pastedText.trim()) return;
123:     setSource('manual_narrative');
124:     setEditableText(pastedText.trim());
125:     setRawOcrText(pastedText.trim());
126:     setOcrResult(null); // Explicitly NO OCR result, NO fake confidence
127:     setAnalyzedReport(null);
128:     setAnalysisData(null);
129:     setStep(3); // Directly advance to 03 Verify & Review (skipping 02 OCR)
130:   };
131: 
132:   // Handle Camera Capture
133:   const handleCameraCapture = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
134:     if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
135:       const file = e.target.files[0];
136:       setSelectedFile(file);
137:       setSource('camera');
138:       setAnalyzedReport(null);
139:       setAnalysisData(null);
140:       processOCR(file);
141:     }
142:   };
143: 
144:   // Run Automated Pipeline Analysis
145:   const handleRunAnalysis = async () => {
146:     if (!editableText.trim()) return;
147:     setAnalyzing(true);
148:     setAnalysisStage('Analyzing safety report...');
149:     setError(null);
150:     setAnalyzedReport(null);
151:     setAnalysisData(null);
152: 
153:     try {
154:       // 1. Text Processing
155:       setAnalysisStage('01 Processing text & domain terminology...');
156:       await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200));
157: 
158:       // 2. Submit report to backend
159:       setAnalysisStage('02 Extracting 10-dimension safety signals...');
160:       const blob = new Blob([editableText], { type: 'text/plain' });
161:       const file = new File([blob], source === 'manual_narrative' ? 'manual_narrative.txt' : 'ingested_report.txt', { type: 'text/plain' });
162:       
163:       const importRes = await importReports(file, 'oil_hsse');
164: 
165:       setAnalysisStage('03 Executing XGBoost SIF classifier (v1.0.0)...');
166:       await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200));
167: 
168:       setAnalysisStage('04 Mapping IOGP 9 Life-Saving Rules & Fingerprint...');
169:       
170:       // Fetch the exact newly created report record using returned first_imported_id
171:       let targetReportId = importRes.first_imported_id || null;
172:       if (!targetReportId) {
173:         const recentReports = await listReports(0, 1);
174:         targetReportId = recentReports.length > 0 ? recentReports[0].id : null;
175:       }
176: 
177:       if (targetReportId) {
178:         const targetReport = await getReport(targetReportId);
179:         setAnalyzedReport(targetReport);
180:         try {
181:           const fullAnalysis = await analyzeReport(targetReportId);
182:           setAnalysisData(fullAnalysis);
183:         } catch {
184:           // Fallback if analysis object already saved
185:         }
186:       }
187: 
188:       setAnalysisStage('05 Analysis complete.');
189:       setStep(4);
190:     } catch (err: any) {
191:       setError(err.message || 'Failed to submit report for analysis');
192:     } finally {
193:       setAnalyzing(false);
194:     }
195:   };
196: 
197:   const handleReset = () => {
198:     setStep(1);
199:     setOcrResult(null);
200:     setSelectedFile(null);
201:     setPastedText('');
202:     setEditableText('');
203:     setRawOcrText('');
204:     setAnalyzedReport(null);
205:     setAnalysisData(null);
206:     setError(null);
207:   };
208: 
209:   // Helper for source badge label
210:   const getSourceBadge = () => {
211:     switch (source) {
212:       case 'manual_narrative':
213:         return { label: 'MANUAL NARRATIVE', bg: 'rgba(242, 169, 51, 0.15)', color: '#F2A933' };
214:       case 'pdf':
215:         return { label: 'OCR · PDF DOCUMENT', bg: 'rgba(77, 206, 160, 0.15)', color: '#4DCEA0' };
216:       case 'image':
217:         return { label: 'OCR · FIELD IMAGE', bg: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)', color: '#38BDF8' };
218:       case 'camera':
219:         return { label: 'CAMERA CAPTURE', bg: 'rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15)', color: '#A855F7' };
220:       case 'structured':
221:         return { label: 'STRUCTURED REPORT', bg: 'rgba(232, 170, 61, 0.15)', color: '#E8AA3D' };
222:     }
223:   };
224: 
225:   const badge = getSourceBadge();
226: 
227:   return (
228:     <motion.div
229:       initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
230:       animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
231:       transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
232:       style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '24px' }}
233:     >
234:       {/* Header Bar */}
235:       <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
236:         <div>
237:           <h1
238:             style={{
239:               fontFamily: 'var(--font-serif, Fraunces, serif)',
240:               fontSize: '1.75rem',
241:               fontWeight: 600,
242:               color: 'var(--text-primary, #F4F3EE)',
243:               margin: '0 0 4px 0',
244:             }}
245:           >
246:             Capture Safety Report & Intelligence Pipeline
247:           </h1>
248:           <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary, #9CA8AA)', fontSize: '0.85rem', margin: 0 }}>
249:             Ingest manual narratives, PDF documents, field images, camera captures, or structured records for automated SIF potential analysis.
250:           </p>
251:         </div>
252: 
253:         {step === 4 && (
254:           <button
255:             onClick={handleReset}
256:             className="btn btn-secondary"
257:             style={{
258:               padding: '8px 16px',
259:               borderRadius: '6px',
260:               fontSize: '0.82rem',
261:               display: 'flex',
262:               alignItems: 'center',
263:               gap: '6px',
264:             }}
265:           >
266:             <RotateCcw size={15} /> Capture Another Report
267:           </button>
268:         )}
269:       </div>
270: 
271:       {error && <ErrorBanner message={error} onRetry={() => setError(null)} />}
272: 
273:       {/* 4-Step Pipeline Indicator */}
274:       <div
275:         style={{
276:           display: 'grid',
277:           gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr))',
278:           gap: '12px',
279:           backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-card, #0D171A)',
280:           border: '1px solid var(--border, #203238)',
281:           borderRadius: '8px',
282:           padding: '16px',
283:         }}
284:       >
285:         {/* Step 01 */}
286:         <div
287:           style={{
288:             display: 'flex',
289:             alignItems: 'center',
290:             gap: '10px',
291:             padding: '10px 14px',
292:             borderRadius: '6px',
293:             backgroundColor: step === 1
294:               ? 'rgba(242, 169, 51, 0.15)'
295:               : step > 1
296:               ? 'rgba(77, 206, 160, 0.12)'
297:               : 'rgba(17, 36, 41, 0.5)',
298:             border: `1px solid ${step === 1 ? '#F2A933' : step > 1 ? '#4DCEA0' : '#203238'}`,
299:           }}
300:         >
301:           <span style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontSize: '0.9rem', fontWeight: 700, color: step === 1 ? '#F2A933' : step > 1 ? '#4DCEA0' : '#647477' }}>
302:             01
303:           </span>
304:           <div>
305:             <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#F4F3EE' }}>01 Capture</div>
306:             <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#9CA8AA' }}>
307:               {step > 1 ? '✓ Complete' : 'PDF / Narrative / Camera'}
308:             </div>
309:           </div>
310:         </div>
311: 
312:         {/* Step 02: OCR Dynamic State */}
313:         <div
314:           style={{
315:             display: 'flex',
316:             alignItems: 'center',
317:             gap: '10px',
318:             padding: '10px 14px',
319:             borderRadius: '6px',
320:             backgroundColor: !isOcrSource
321:               ? 'rgba(100, 116, 119, 0.08)' // Muted skipped state for manual narrative
322:               : step === 2
323:               ? 'rgba(242, 169, 51, 0.15)'
324:               : step > 2
325:               ? 'rgba(77, 206, 160, 0.12)'
326:               : 'rgba(17, 36, 41, 0.5)',
327:             border: `1px solid ${
328:               !isOcrSource
329:                 ? 'rgba(100, 116, 119, 0.25)'
330:                 : step === 2
331:                 ? '#F2A933'
332:                 : step > 2
333:                 ? '#4DCEA0'
334:                 : '#203238'
335:             }`,
336:           }}
337:         >
338:           <span
339:             style={{
340:               fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)',
341:               fontSize: '0.9rem',
342:               fontWeight: 700,
343:               color: !isOcrSource ? '#647477' : step === 2 ? '#F2A933' : step > 2 ? '#4DCEA0' : '#647477',
344:             }}
345:           >
346:             02
347:           </span>
348:           <div>
349:             <div
350:               style={{
351:                 fontSize: '0.82rem',
352:                 fontWeight: 600,
353:                 color: !isOcrSource ? '#829195' : '#F4F3EE',
354:               }}
355:             >
356:               02 OCR
357:             </div>
358:             <div
359:               style={{
360:                 fontSize: '0.72rem',
361:                 color: !isOcrSource ? '#647477' : step > 2 ? '#4DCEA0' : '#9CA8AA',
362:                 fontStyle: !isOcrSource ? 'italic' : 'normal',
363:               }}
364:             >
365:               {!isOcrSource
366:                 ? '— Skipped (Direct text)'
367:                 : step === 2
368:                 ? '→ Processing...'
369:                 : step > 2
370:                 ? '✓ OCR Complete'
371:                 : 'Pending'}
372:             </div>
373:           </div>
374:         </div>
375: 
376:         {/* Step 03 */}
377:         <div
378:           style={{
379:             display: 'flex',
380:             alignItems: 'center',
381:             gap: '10px',
382:             padding: '10px 14px',
383:             borderRadius: '6px',
384:             backgroundColor: step === 3
385:               ? 'rgba(242, 169, 51, 0.15)'
386:               : step > 3
387:               ? 'rgba(77, 206, 160, 0.12)'
388:               : 'rgba(17, 36, 41, 0.5)',
389:             border: `1px solid ${step === 3 ? '#F2A933' : step > 3 ? '#4DCEA0' : '#203238'}`,
390:           }}
391:         >
392:           <span style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontSize: '0.9rem', fontWeight: 700, color: step === 3 ? '#F2A933' : step > 3 ? '#4DCEA0' : '#647477' }}>
393:             03
394:           </span>
395:           <div>
396:             <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#F4F3EE' }}>03 Verify & Review</div>
397:             <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#9CA8AA' }}>
398:               {step === 3 ? '→ Current' : step > 3 ? '✓ Complete' : 'Pending'}
399:             </div>
400:           </div>
401:         </div>
402: 
403:         {/* Step 04 */}
404:         <div
405:           style={{
406:             display: 'flex',
407:             alignItems: 'center',
408:             gap: '10px',
409:             padding: '10px 14px',
410:             borderRadius: '6px',
411:             backgroundColor: step === 4
412:               ? 'rgba(77, 206, 160, 0.15)'
413:               : 'rgba(17, 36, 41, 0.5)',
414:             border: `1px solid ${step === 4 ? '#4DCEA0' : '#203238'}`,
415:           }}
416:         >
417:           <span style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontSize: '0.9rem', fontWeight: 700, color: step === 4 ? '#4DCEA0' : '#647477' }}>
418:             04
419:           </span>
420:           <div>
421:             <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#F4F3EE' }}>04 Safety Intelligence</div>
422:             <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: step === 4 ? '#4DCEA0' : '#9CA8AA' }}>
423:               {step === 4 ? '✓ Complete' : 'Pending'}
424:             </div>
425:           </div>
426:         </div>
427:       </div>
428: 
429:       {/* Step 1: Ingestion Source Selector & Input Form */}
430:       {step === 1 && (
431:         <div
432:           style={{
433:             backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-card, #0D171A)',
434:             border: '1px solid var(--border, #203238)',
435:             borderRadius: '8px',
436:             padding: '28px',
437:             display: 'flex',
438:             flexDirection: 'column',
439:             gap: '20px',
440:           }}
441:         >
442:           {/* Source Selection Toolbar */}
443:           <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '10px', flexWrap: 'wrap', borderBottom: '1px solid #203238', paddingBottom: '16px' }}>
444:             <button
445:               onClick={() => setSource('pdf')}
446:               style={{
447:                 padding: '10px 18px',
448:                 borderRadius: '6px',
449:                 border: '1px solid',
450:                 borderColor: source === 'pdf' || source === 'image' ? '#F2A933' : '#203238',
451:                 backgroundColor: source === 'pdf' || source === 'image' ? 'rgba(242, 169, 51, 0.12)' : 'transparent',
452:                 color: source === 'pdf' || source === 'image' ? '#F2A933' : '#9CA8AA',
453:                 fontSize: '0.85rem',
454:                 fontWeight: 600,
455:                 cursor: 'pointer',
456:                 display: 'flex',
457:                 alignItems: 'center',
458:                 gap: '8px',
459:               }}
460:             >
461:               <UploadCloud size={16} /> Upload Document (PDF / Image)
462:             </button>
463: 
464:             <button
465:               onClick={() => setSource('manual_narrative')}
466:               style={{
467:                 padding: '10px 18px',
468:                 borderRadius: '6px',
469:                 border: '1px solid',
470:                 borderColor: source === 'manual_narrative' ? '#F2A933' : '#203238',
471:                 backgroundColor: source === 'manual_narrative' ? 'rgba(242, 169, 51, 0.12)' : 'transparent',
472:                 color: source === 'manual_narrative' ? '#F2A933' : '#9CA8AA',
473:                 fontSize: '0.85rem',
474:                 fontWeight: 600,
475:                 cursor: 'pointer',
476:                 display: 'flex',
477:                 alignItems: 'center',
478:                 gap: '8px',
479:               }}
480:             >
481:               <FileText size={16} /> Paste Narrative
482:             </button>
483: 
484:             <button
485:               onClick={() => {
486:                 setSource('camera');
487:                 setIsCameraModalOpen(true);
488:               }}
489:               style={{
490:                 padding: '10px 18px',
491:                 borderRadius: '6px',
492:                 border: '1px solid',
493:                 borderColor: source === 'camera' ? '#F2A933' : '#203238',
494:                 backgroundColor: source === 'camera' ? 'rgba(242, 169, 51, 0.12)' : 'transparent',
495:                 color: source === 'camera' ? '#F2A933' : '#9CA8AA',
496:                 fontSize: '0.85rem',
497:                 fontWeight: 600,
498:                 cursor: 'pointer',
499:                 display: 'flex',
500:                 alignItems: 'center',
501:                 gap: '8px',
502:               }}
503:             >
504:               <Camera size={16} /> Live Camera Capture
505:             </button>
506: 
507:             <button
508:               onClick={() => setSource('structured')}
509:               style={{
510:                 padding: '10px 18px',
511:                 borderRadius: '6px',
512:                 border: '1px solid',
513:                 borderColor: source === 'structured' ? '#F2A933' : '#203238',
514:                 backgroundColor: source === 'structured' ? 'rgba(242, 169, 51, 0.12)' : 'transparent',
515:                 color: source === 'structured' ? '#F2A933' : '#9CA8AA',
516:                 fontSize: '0.85rem',
517:                 fontWeight: 600,
518:                 cursor: 'pointer',
519:                 display: 'flex',
520:                 alignItems: 'center',
521:                 gap: '8px',
522:               }}
523:             >
524:               <Database size={16} /> Structured Report (CSV / JSON)
525:             </button>
526:           </div>
527: 
528:           <input
529:             ref={cameraInputRef}
530:             type="file"
531:             accept="image/*"
532:             capture="environment"
533:             onChange={handleCameraCapture}
534:             style={{ display: 'none' }}
535:           />
536: 
537:           {/* Mode 1: Document / Image File Dropzone */}
538:           {(source === 'pdf' || source === 'image' || source === 'structured') && (
539:             <div
540:               onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
541:               onDragOver={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setIsDragging(true); }}
542:               onDragLeave={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setIsDragging(false); }}
543:               onDrop={(e) => {
544:                 e.preventDefault();
545:                 setIsDragging(false);
546:                 if (e.dataTransfer.files?.[0]) {
547:                   const file = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
548:                   if (file.name.endsWith('.csv') || file.name.endsWith('.json')) {
549:                     setSource('structured');
550:                     processStructuredFile(file);
551:                   } else {
552:                     processOCR(file);
553:                   }
554:                 }
555:               }}
556:               style={{
557:                 border: `2px dashed ${isDragging ? '#F2A933' : '#203238'}`,
558:                 borderRadius: '8px',
559:                 padding: '48px 24px',
560:                 textAlign: 'center',
561:                 cursor: 'pointer',
562:                 backgroundColor: isDragging ? 'rgba(242, 169, 51, 0.05)' : 'rgba(17, 36, 41, 0.4)',
563:                 transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
564:               }}
565:             >
566:               <input
567:                 ref={fileInputRef}
568:                 type="file"
569:                 accept=".pdf,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.csv,.json,.txt"
570:                 onChange={handleFileChange}
571:                 style={{ display: 'none' }}
572:               />
573:               <UploadCloud size={48} color="#F2A933" style={{ marginBottom: '12px' }} />
574:               <h3 style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-serif)', color: '#F4F3EE', margin: '0 0 6px 0' }}>
575:                 Drag and drop report document or click to browse
576:               </h3>
577:               <p style={{ color: '#9CA8AA', fontSize: '0.82rem', margin: 0 }}>
578:                 Supports PDF reports, scanned forms, site photo logs (PNG/JPG), and structured CSV/JSON logs.
579:               </p>
580:             </div>
581:           )}
582: 
583:           {/* Mode 2: Manual Narrative Text Area */}
584:           {source === 'manual_narrative' && (
585:             <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '14px' }}>
586:               <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
587:                 <label style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#F4F3EE' }}>
588:                   Enter Human Safety Observation Narrative:
589:                 </label>
590:                 <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#829195', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
591:                   OCR will be skipped automatically for direct text entry
592:                 </span>
593:               </div>
594:               <textarea
595:                 value={pastedText}
596:                 onChange={(e) => setPastedText(e.target.value)}
597:                 placeholder="Paste or type original HSE field observation narrative..."
598:                 rows={8}
599:                 style={{
600:                   width: '100%',
601:                   backgroundColor: '#091114',
602:                   border: '1px solid #203238',
603:                   borderRadius: '6px',
604:                   padding: '14px',
605:                   color: '#F4F3EE',
606:                   fontSize: '0.9rem',
607:                   fontFamily: 'Inter, sans-serif',
608:                   lineHeight: 1.5,
609:                 }}
610:               />
611:               <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
612:                 <button
613:                   onClick={handlePasteSubmit}
614:                   disabled={!pastedText.trim()}
615:                   style={{
616:                     padding: '10px 22px',
617:                     borderRadius: '6px',
618:                     backgroundColor: '#F2A933',
619:                     color: '#080E10',
620:                     border: 'none',

2: import { listReports, analyzeReport } from '../api/reports';
3: import { getSimilarReports } from '../api/patterns';
4: import type { SafetyReportRead, AnalysisResponse, SimilarReport } from '../types/api';
5: import { SIFBadge } from '../components/common/SIFBadge';
6: import { LoadingSkeleton } from '../components/common/LoadingSkeleton';
7: import { ErrorBanner } from '../components/common/ErrorBanner';
8: import { EmptyState } from '../components/common/EmptyState';
9: import { EvidenceHighlighter } from '../components/common/EvidenceHighlighter';
10: import { AIExplanationPanel } from '../components/common/AIExplanationPanel';
11: import { SafetyFingerprint } from '../components/fingerprint/SafetyFingerprint';
12: import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
13: import {
14:   Search,
15:   Play,
16:   Eye,
17:   Layers,
18:   X,
19:   Sparkles,
20:   Download,
21:   RefreshCw,
22:   ArrowUpDown,
23:   ChevronLeft,
24:   ChevronRight,
25:   ShieldAlert,
26:   AlertCircle,
27:   Database,
28:   HelpCircle,
29:   ArrowRight,
30: } from 'lucide-react';
31: import type { TabId } from '../components/layout/Navigation';
32: 
33: interface Props {
34:   onNavigate: (tab: TabId) => void;
35: }
36: 
37: type SortField = 'priority' | 'confidence' | 'site' | 'activity' | 'hazard' | 'id';
38: type ViewMode = 'ALL' | 'PRIORITY' | 'SIF_ONLY' | 'UNCERTAIN_ONLY';
39: 
40: export const ReportsExplorerPage: React.FC<Props> = ({ onNavigate }) => {
41:   const [reports, setReports] = useState<SafetyReportRead[]>([]);
42:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
43:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
44:   const [isRefreshing, setIsRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
45:   const [lastSyncTime, setLastSyncTime] = useState<Date>(new Date());
46: 
47:   // Search & Filter state
48:   const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
49:   const [sifFilter, setSifFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
50:   const [sourceFilter, setSourceFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
51:   const [siteFilter, setSiteFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
52:   const [hazardFilter, setHazardFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
53:   const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<ViewMode>('ALL');
54: 
55:   // Sorting & Pagination state
56:   const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<SortField>('priority');
57:   const [sortDirection, setSortDirection] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('desc');
58:   const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState<number>(1);
59:   const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState<number>(25);
60: 
61:   // Selected Report Detail Drawer
62:   const [selectedReport, setSelectedReport] = useState<SafetyReportRead | null>(null);
63:   const [analysisData, setAnalysisData] = useState<AnalysisResponse | null>(null);
64:   const [similarReports, setSimilarReports] = useState<SimilarReport[]>([]);
65:   const [analyzing, setAnalyzing] = useState<boolean>(false);
66: 
67:   const searchInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
68: 
69:   const handleRefresh = () => {
70:     setIsRefreshing(true);
71:     setError(null);
72: 
73:     listReports(0, 500, sourceFilter === 'ALL' ? undefined : sourceFilter, sifFilter === 'ALL' ? undefined : sifFilter)
74:       .then((data) => {
75:         setReports(data);
76:         setLastSyncTime(new Date());
77:         setIsRefreshing(false);
78:       })
79:       .catch((err) => {
80:         setError(err.message || 'Failed to fetch reports');
81:         setIsRefreshing(false);
82:       });
83:   };
84: 
85:   useEffect(() => {
86:     let isMounted = true;
87:     setLoading(true);
88:     setError(null);
89: 
90:     listReports(0, 500, sourceFilter === 'ALL' ? undefined : sourceFilter, sifFilter === 'ALL' ? undefined : sifFilter)
91:       .then((data) => {
92:         if (!isMounted) return;
93:         setReports(data);
94:         setLastSyncTime(new Date());
95:         setLoading(false);
96:       })
97:       .catch((err) => {
98:         if (!isMounted) return;
99:         setError(err.message || 'Failed to fetch reports');
100:         setLoading(false);
101:       });
102: 
103:     return () => {
104:       isMounted = false;
105:     };
106:   }, [sifFilter, sourceFilter]);
107: 
108:   // Global Keyboard Shortcuts: '/' focuses search, 'Escape' closes detail drawer
109:   useEffect(() => {
110:     const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
111:       if (e.key === 'Escape') {
112:         if (selectedReport) {
113:           setSelectedReport(null);
114:         }
115:       } else if (e.key === '/' && !selectedReport && document.activeElement !== searchInputRef.current) {
116:         const tag = (e.target as HTMLElement)?.tagName?.toLowerCase();
117:         if (tag !== 'input' && tag !== 'textarea') {
118:           e.preventDefault();
119:           searchInputRef.current?.focus();
120:         }
121:       }
122:     };
123:     window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
124:     return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
125:   }, [selectedReport]);
126: 
127:   // Dynamic unique lists derived from live records
128:   const uniqueSites = useMemo(() => {
129:     const set = new Set<string>();
130:     reports.forEach((r) => {
131:       const siteName = (r.site || r.employer || '').trim();
132:       if (siteName) set.add(siteName);
133:     });
134:     return Array.from(set).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
135:   }, [reports]);
136: 
137:   const uniqueHazards = useMemo(() => {
138:     const set = new Set<string>();
139:     reports.forEach((r) => {
140:       const h = (r.hazard || '').trim();
141:       if (h) set.add(h);
142:     });
143:     return Array.from(set).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
144:   }, [reports]);
145: 
146:   // KPI Calculations strictly from loaded dataset (zero fake metrics)
147:   const stats = useMemo(() => {
148:     const total = reports.length;
149:     const sifCount = reports.filter((r) => r.sif_potential === 'SIF_POTENTIAL').length;
150:     const uncertainCount = reports.filter((r) => r.sif_potential === 'UNCERTAIN').length;
151:     const nonSifCount = reports.filter((r) => r.sif_potential === 'NON_SIF').length;
152:     const highPriorityCount = reports.filter(
153:       (r) =>
154:         r.sif_potential === 'SIF_POTENTIAL' &&
155:         ((r.sif_confidence || r.sif_score || 0) >= 0.8 || Boolean(r.barrier_failure))
156:     ).length;
157:     const barrierDefectCount = reports.filter((r) => Boolean(r.barrier_failure)).length;
158:     const sifDensity = total > 0 ? (sifCount / total) * 100 : 0;
159: 
160:     return {
161:       total,
162:       sifCount,
163:       uncertainCount,
164:       nonSifCount,
165:       highPriorityCount,
166:       barrierDefectCount,
167:       sifDensity,
168:     };
169:   }, [reports]);
170: 
171:   // Filtered reports pipeline
172:   const filteredReports = useMemo(() => {
173:     return reports.filter((r) => {
174:       // 1. Search Query
175:       if (searchQuery.trim()) {
176:         const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
177:         const matchesQuery =
178:           r.report_text.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
179:           (r.activity && r.activity.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
180:           (r.hazard && r.hazard.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
181:           (r.site && r.site.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
182:           (r.employer && r.employer.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
183:           (r.barrier_failure && r.barrier_failure.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
184:           (r.energy_source && r.energy_source.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
185:           (r.source_record_id && r.source_record_id.toLowerCase().includes(q));
186: 
187:         if (!matchesQuery) return false;
188:       }
189: 
190:       // 2. Site Filter
191:       if (siteFilter !== 'ALL') {
192:         const rSite = (r.site || r.employer || '').trim();
193:         if (rSite !== siteFilter) return false;
194:       }
195: 
196:       // 3. Hazard Filter
197:       if (hazardFilter !== 'ALL') {
198:         const rHazard = (r.hazard || '').trim();
199:         if (rHazard !== hazardFilter) return false;
200:       }
201: 
202:       // 4. View Mode
203:       if (viewMode === 'PRIORITY') {
204:         const isPriority =
205:           r.sif_potential === 'SIF_POTENTIAL' &&
206:           ((r.sif_confidence || r.sif_score || 0) >= 0.8 || Boolean(r.barrier_failure));
207:         if (!isPriority) return false;
208:       } else if (viewMode === 'SIF_ONLY') {
209:         if (r.sif_potential !== 'SIF_POTENTIAL') return false;
210:       } else if (viewMode === 'UNCERTAIN_ONLY') {
211:         if (r.sif_potential !== 'UNCERTAIN') return false;
212:       }
213: 
214:       return true;
215:     });
216:   }, [reports, searchQuery, siteFilter, hazardFilter, viewMode]);
217: 
218:   // Sorted reports pipeline
219:   const sortedReports = useMemo(() => {
220:     const list = [...filteredReports];
221:     return list.sort((a, b) => {
222:       if (sortBy === 'priority') {
223:         // High priority SIF precursors with barrier defects first
224:         const aScore =
225:           (a.sif_potential === 'SIF_POTENTIAL' ? 2 : a.sif_potential === 'UNCERTAIN' ? 1 : 0) * 100 +
226:           (a.barrier_failure ? 30 : 0) +
227:           (a.sif_confidence || a.sif_score || 0) * 50;
228:         const bScore =
229:           (b.sif_potential === 'SIF_POTENTIAL' ? 2 : b.sif_potential === 'UNCERTAIN' ? 1 : 0) * 100 +
230:           (b.barrier_failure ? 30 : 0) +
231:           (b.sif_confidence || b.sif_score || 0) * 50;
232:         return sortDirection === 'asc' ? aScore - bScore : bScore - aScore;
233:       }
234: 
235:       if (sortBy === 'confidence') {
236:         const aConf = a.sif_confidence || a.sif_score || 0;
237:         const bConf = b.sif_confidence || b.sif_score || 0;
238:         return sortDirection === 'asc' ? aConf - bConf : bConf - aConf;
239:       }
240: 
241:       if (sortBy === 'site') {
242:         const aSite = a.site || a.employer || '';
243:         const bSite = b.site || b.employer || '';
244:         return sortDirection === 'asc' ? aSite.localeCompare(bSite) : bSite.localeCompare(aSite);
245:       }
246: 
247:       if (sortBy === 'activity') {
248:         const aAct = a.activity || '';
249:         const bAct = b.activity || '';
250:         return sortDirection === 'asc' ? aAct.localeCompare(bAct) : bAct.localeCompare(aAct);
251:       }
252: 
253:       if (sortBy === 'hazard') {
254:         const aHaz = a.hazard || '';
255:         const bHaz = b.hazard || '';
256:         return sortDirection === 'asc' ? aHaz.localeCompare(bHaz) : bHaz.localeCompare(aHaz);
257:       }
258: 
259:       if (sortBy === 'id') {
260:         return sortDirection === 'asc'
261:           ? a.source_record_id.localeCompare(b.source_record_id)
262:           : b.source_record_id.localeCompare(a.source_record_id);
263:       }
264: 
265:       return 0;
266:     });
267:   }, [filteredReports, sortBy, sortDirection]);
268: 
269:   // Paginated slice with automatic bounds safety
270:   const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(sortedReports.length / pageSize));
271:   const safeCurrentPage = Math.min(Math.max(1, currentPage), totalPages);
272:   const paginatedReports = useMemo(() => {
273:     const startIndex = (safeCurrentPage - 1) * pageSize;
274:     return sortedReports.slice(startIndex, startIndex + pageSize);
275:   }, [sortedReports, safeCurrentPage, pageSize]);
276: 
277:   // Active filters count and list for chips
278:   const activeFilters = useMemo(() => {
279:     const list: { key: string; label: string; value: string; clear: () => void }[] = [];
280: 
281:     if (searchQuery.trim()) {
282:       list.push({
283:         key: 'search',
284:         label: 'Search',
285:         value: `"${searchQuery.trim()}"`,
286:         clear: () => setSearchQuery(''),
287:       });
288:     }
289: 
290:     if (viewMode !== 'ALL') {
291:       const modeLabel =
292:         viewMode === 'PRIORITY'
293:           ? 'High Priority'
294:           : viewMode === 'SIF_ONLY'
295:           ? 'SIF Signals Only'
296:           : 'Uncertain Only';
297:       list.push({
298:         key: 'viewMode',
299:         label: 'View',
300:         value: modeLabel,
301:         clear: () => setViewMode('ALL'),
302:       });
303:     }
304: 
305:     if (sifFilter !== 'ALL') {
306:       const sifLabels: Record<string, string> = {
307:         SIF_POTENTIAL: 'SIF Precursors',
308:         NON_SIF: 'Non-SIF',
309:         UNCERTAIN: 'Uncertain',
310:       };
311:       list.push({
312:         key: 'sif',
313:         label: 'Classification',
314:         value: sifLabels[sifFilter] || sifFilter,
315:         clear: () => setSifFilter('ALL'),
316:       });
317:     }
318: 
319:     if (sourceFilter !== 'ALL') {
320:       list.push({
321:         key: 'source',
322:         label: 'Source',
323:         value: sourceFilter,
324:         clear: () => setSourceFilter('ALL'),
325:       });
326:     }
327: 
328:     if (siteFilter !== 'ALL') {
329:       list.push({
330:         key: 'site',
331:         label: 'Site',
332:         value: siteFilter,
333:         clear: () => setSiteFilter('ALL'),
334:       });
335:     }
336: 
337:     if (hazardFilter !== 'ALL') {
338:       list.push({
339:         key: 'hazard',
340:         label: 'Hazard',
341:         value: hazardFilter,
342:         clear: () => setHazardFilter('ALL'),
343:       });
344:     }
345: 
346:     return list;
347:   }, [searchQuery, viewMode, sifFilter, sourceFilter, siteFilter, hazardFilter]);
348: 
349:   const clearAllFilters = () => {
350:     setSearchQuery('');
351:     setSifFilter('ALL');
352:     setSourceFilter('ALL');
353:     setSiteFilter('ALL');
354:     setHazardFilter('ALL');
355:     setViewMode('ALL');
356:   };
357: 
358:   const handleOpenReport = (report: SafetyReportRead) => {
359:     setSelectedReport(report);
360:     setAnalysisData(null);
361:     setSimilarReports([]);
362: 
363:     if (!report.sif_potential) {
364:       handleRunAnalysis(report.id);
365:     } else {
366:       getSimilarReports(report.id, 4)
367:         .then((res) => setSimilarReports(res.similar_reports))
368:         .catch(() => {});
369:     }
370:   };
371: 
372:   const handleRunAnalysis = (reportId: string) => {
373:     setAnalyzing(true);
374:     analyzeReport(reportId)
375:       .then((res) => {
376:         setAnalysisData(res);
377:         setAnalyzing(false);
378:         handleRefresh();
379:         getSimilarReports(reportId, 4)
380:           .then((sim) => setSimilarReports(sim.similar_reports))
381:           .catch(() => {});
382:       })
383:       .catch(() => {
384:         setAnalyzing(false);
385:       });
386:   };
387: 
388:   // Step through reports in drawer
389:   const selectedIndex = useMemo(() => {
390:     if (!selectedReport) return -1;
391:     return sortedReports.findIndex((r) => r.id === selectedReport.id);
392:   }, [selectedReport, sortedReports]);
393: 
394:   const handleNavigateDrawer = (delta: number) => {
395:     if (selectedIndex === -1) return;
396:     const nextIdx = selectedIndex + delta;
397:     if (nextIdx >= 0 && nextIdx < sortedReports.length) {
398:       handleOpenReport(sortedReports[nextIdx]);
399:     }
400:   };
401: 
402:   const exportFilteredCSV = () => {
403:     if (sortedReports.length === 0) return;
404:     const headers = [
405:       'Record ID',
406:       'Source Dataset',
407:       'Site / Employer',
408:       'Activity / Task',
409:       'Hazard',
410:       'Barrier Failure',
411:       'SIF Classification',
412:       'SIF Confidence',
413:       'Energy Source',
414:       'Narrative',
415:     ];
416:     const rows = sortedReports.map((r) => [
417:       `"${r.source_record_id}"`,
418:       `"${r.source_dataset}"`,
419:       `"${(r.site || r.employer || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
420:       `"${(r.activity || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
421:       `"${(r.hazard || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
422:       `"${(r.barrier_failure || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
423:       `"${r.sif_potential || 'UNANALYZED'}"`,
424:       `"${r.sif_confidence || r.sif_score || 0}"`,
425:       `"${(r.energy_source || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
426:       `"${r.report_text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
427:     ]);
428:     const csvContent = 'data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,' + [headers.join(','), ...rows.map((e) => e.join(','))].join('\n');
429:     const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
430:     const link = document.createElement('a');
431:     link.setAttribute('href', encodedUri);
432:     link.setAttribute('download', `sif_guard_intelligence_export_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`);
433:     document.body.appendChild(link);
434:     link.click();
435:     document.body.removeChild(link);
436:   };
437: 
438:   return (
439:     <motion.div
440:       initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
441:       animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
442:       transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: 'easeOut' }}
443:       style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '20px', width: '100%' }}
444:     >
445:       {/* 1. Page Header */}
446:       <div
447:         style={{
448:           display: 'flex',
449:           justifyContent: 'space-between',
450:           alignItems: 'flex-start',
451:           flexWrap: 'wrap',
452:           gap: '16px',
453:         }}
454:       >
455:         <div>
456:           <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
457:             <h2 className="section-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
458:               Incident & Observation Intelligence Explorer
459:             </h2>
460:             <span
461:               style={{
462:                 fontSize: '0.72rem',
463:                 fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)',
464:                 color: 'var(--success)',
465:                 background: 'rgba(32, 217, 151, 0.10)',
466:                 border: '1px solid rgba(32, 217, 151, 0.25)',
467:                 padding: '2px 8px',
468:                 borderRadius: '6px',
469:                 display: 'inline-flex',
470:                 alignItems: 'center',
471:                 gap: '5px',
472:                 fontWeight: 600,
473:               }}
474:             >
475:               <span
476:                 style={{
477:                   width: '6px',
478:                   height: '6px',
479:                   borderRadius: '50%',
480:                   background: 'var(--success)',
481:                 }}
482:               />
483:               SYSTEM LIVE
484:             </span>
485:           </div>
486:           <p style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', margin: 0 }}>
487:             Browse, filter, and inspect Serious Injury & Fatality (SIF) precursor intelligence across safety reports.
488:           </p>
489:         </div>
490: 
491:         <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
492:           <button
493:             onClick={handleRefresh}
494:             disabled={isRefreshing}
495:             className="btn btn-secondary"
496:             style={{ padding: '8px 14px', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}
497:             title={`Last synced: ${lastSyncTime.toLocaleTimeString()}`}
498:           >
499:             <RefreshCw size={14} className={isRefreshing ? 'spin-anim' : ''} />
500:             <span>Sync Telemetry</span>
501:           </button>
502: 
503:           <button onClick={exportFilteredCSV} className="btn btn-secondary" style={{ padding: '8px 14px', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
504:             <Download size={14} />
505:             <span>Export CSV</span>
506:           </button>
507: 
508:           <button onClick={() => onNavigate('ingestion')} className="btn btn-primary" style={{ padding: '8px 16px', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
509:             + Import New Dataset
510:           </button>
511:         </div>
512:       </div>
513: 
514:       {/* 2. Intelligence Summary KPI Row */}
515:       <div
516:         style={{
517:           display: 'grid',
518:           gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))',
519:           gap: '14px',
520:         }}
521:       >
522:         {/* KPI 1: Total Records */}
523:         <div className="card" style={{ padding: '16px 20px', borderRadius: '14px', position: 'relative' }}>
524:           <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
525:             <div>
526:               <span className="micro-label">TOTAL RECORDS</span>
527:               <div
528:                 className="numeric-display"
529:                 style={{ fontSize: '1.65rem', fontWeight: 700, margin: '6px 0 2px 0' }}
530:               >
531:                 {stats.total.toLocaleString()}
532:               </div>
533:               <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
534:                 Ingested safety observations
535:               </div>
536:             </div>
537:             <div
538:               style={{
539:                 width: '36px',
540:                 height: '36px',
541:                 borderRadius: '10px',
542:                 background: 'var(--surface-elevated)',
543:                 border: '1px solid var(--border)',
544:                 display: 'flex',
545:                 alignItems: 'center',
546:                 justifyContent: 'center',
547:                 color: 'var(--primary)',
548:               }}
549:             >
550:               <Database size={18} />
551:             </div>
552:           </div>
553:         </div>
554: 
555:         {/* KPI 2: SIF Signals */}
556:         <div
557:           className="card"
558:           style={{
559:             padding: '16px 20px',
560:             borderRadius: '14px',
561:             borderLeft: '3px solid var(--danger)',
562:           }}
563:         >
564:           <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
565:             <div>
566:               <span className="micro-label" style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>SIF SIGNALS</span>
567:               <div
568:                 className="numeric-display"
569:                 style={{
570:                   fontSize: '1.65rem',
571:                   fontWeight: 700,
572:                   margin: '6px 0 2px 0',
573:                   color: 'var(--danger)',
574:                 }}
575:               >
576:                 {stats.sifCount.toLocaleString()}
577:               </div>
578:               <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>
579:                 {stats.sifDensity.toFixed(1)}% of total records
580:               </div>
581:             </div>
582:             <div
583:               style={{
584:                 width: '36px',
585:                 height: '36px',
586:                 borderRadius: '10px',
587:                 background: 'rgba(232, 93, 93, 0.12)',
588:                 border: '1px solid rgba(232, 93, 93, 0.25)',
589:                 display: 'flex',
590:                 alignItems: 'center',
591:                 justifyContent: 'center',
592:                 color: 'var(--danger)',
593:               }}
594:             >
595:               <ShieldAlert size={18} />
596:             </div>
597:           </div>
598:         </div>
599:

633:                 border: '1px solid rgba(255, 179, 71, 0.25)',

635:                 alignItems: 'center',
636:                 justifyContent: 'center',
637:                 color: 'var(--warning)',
638:               }}

649:             padding: '16px 20px',
650:             borderRadius: '14px',
651:             borderLeft: '3px solid var(--primary)',

662:                   margin: '6px 0 2px 0',

664:                 }}
665:               >

674:                 width: '36px',
675:                 height: '36px',
676:                 borderRadius: '10px',

693:         className="card"

695:           padding: '16px 20px',
696:           borderRadius: '14px',
697:           display: 'flex',
698:           flexDirection: 'column',
699:           gap: '14px',
700:         }}
701:       >
702:         {/* Top search & Quick View Mode buttons */}
703:         <div
704:           style={{
705:             display: 'flex',
706:             gap: '12px',
707:             alignItems: 'center',
708:             flexWrap: 'wrap',
709:           }}
710:         >
711:           {/* Primary Search Bar */}

713:             <Search
714:               size={17}
715:               color="var(--text-muted)"

717:                 position: 'absolute',

719:                 top: '50%',
720:                 transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
721:               }}
722:             />
723:             <input
724:               ref={searchInputRef}
725:               type="text"
