729:               style={{
730:                 width: '100%',
731:                 padding: '9px 36px 9px 38px',
732:                 borderRadius: '9px',
733:                 border: '1px solid var(--border)',
734:                 background: 'var(--surface-elevated)',
735:                 color: 'var(--text-primary)',
736:                 fontSize: '0.85rem',
737:                 outline: 'none',
738:                 fontFamily: 'var(--font-main)',
739:               }}
740:             />
741:             {searchQuery && (
742:               <button
743:                 onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
744:                 style={{
745:                   position: 'absolute',
746:                   right: '10px',
747:                   top: '50%',
748:                   transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
749:                   background: 'transparent',
750:                   border: 'none',
751:                   color: 'var(--text-muted)',
752:                   cursor: 'pointer',
753:                   display: 'flex',
754:                   alignItems: 'center',
755:                 }}
756:               >
757:                 <X size={15} />
758:               </button>
759:             )}
760:           </div>
761: 
762:           {/* Quick View Mode Pills */}
763:           <div
764:             style={{
765:               display: 'flex',
766:               background: 'var(--background-secondary)',
767:               padding: '3px',
768:               borderRadius: '9px',
769:               border: '1px solid var(--border)',
770:             }}
771:           >
772:             <button
773:               onClick={() => setViewMode('ALL')}
774:               style={{
775:                 padding: '6px 12px',
776:                 borderRadius: '7px',
777:                 border: 'none',
778:                 fontSize: '0.78rem',
779:                 fontWeight: 600,
780:                 cursor: 'pointer',
781:                 background: viewMode === 'ALL' ? 'var(--surface-elevated)' : 'transparent',
782:                 color: viewMode === 'ALL' ? 'var(--text-primary)' : 'var(--text-muted)',
783:                 boxShadow: viewMode === 'ALL' ? '0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)' : 'none',
784:                 transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
785:               }}
786:             >
787:               All ({stats.total})
788:             </button>
789:             <button
790:               onClick={() => setViewMode('PRIORITY')}
791:               style={{
792:                 padding: '6px 12px',
793:                 borderRadius: '7px',
794:                 border: 'none',
795:                 fontSize: '0.78rem',
796:                 fontWeight: 600,
797:                 cursor: 'pointer',
798:                 background: viewMode === 'PRIORITY' ? 'rgba(255, 106, 0, 0.18)' : 'transparent',
799:                 color: viewMode === 'PRIORITY' ? 'var(--primary-bright)' : 'var(--text-muted)',
800:                 boxShadow: viewMode === 'PRIORITY' ? '0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)' : 'none',
801:                 transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
802:               }}
803:             >
804:               Priority ({stats.highPriorityCount})
805:             </button>
806:             <button
807:               onClick={() => setViewMode('SIF_ONLY')}
808:               style={{
809:                 padding: '6px 12px',
810:                 borderRadius: '7px',
811:                 border: 'none',
812:                 fontSize: '0.78rem',
813:                 fontWeight: 600,
814:                 cursor: 'pointer',
815:                 background: viewMode === 'SIF_ONLY' ? 'rgba(232, 93, 93, 0.18)' : 'transparent',
816:                 color: viewMode === 'SIF_ONLY' ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--text-muted)',
817:                 boxShadow: viewMode === 'SIF_ONLY' ? '0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)' : 'none',
818:                 transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
819:               }}
820:             >
821:               SIF ({stats.sifCount})
822:             </button>
823:             <button
824:               onClick={() => setViewMode('UNCERTAIN_ONLY')}
825:               style={{
826:                 padding: '6px 12px',
827:                 borderRadius: '7px',
828:                 border: 'none',
829:                 fontSize: '0.78rem',
830:                 fontWeight: 600,
831:                 cursor: 'pointer',
832:                 background: viewMode === 'UNCERTAIN_ONLY' ? 'rgba(255, 179, 71, 0.18)' : 'transparent',
833:                 color: viewMode === 'UNCERTAIN_ONLY' ? 'var(--warning)' : 'var(--text-muted)',
834:                 boxShadow: viewMode === 'UNCERTAIN_ONLY' ? '0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)' : 'none',
835:                 transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
836:               }}
837:             >
838:               Uncertain ({stats.uncertainCount})
839:             </button>
840:           </div>
841:         </div>
842: 
843:         {/* Bottom Dropdowns Row */}
844:         <div
845:           style={{
846:             display: 'flex',
847:             gap: '12px',
848:             alignItems: 'center',
849:             flexWrap: 'wrap',
850:             paddingTop: '10px',
851:             borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
852:           }}
853:         >
854:           {/* SIF Classification Filter */}
855:           <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
856:             <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>
857:               Classification:
858:             </span>
859:             <select
860:               value={sifFilter}
861:               onChange={(e) => setSifFilter(e.target.value)}
862:               style={{
863:                 padding: '6px 10px',
864:                 borderRadius: '7px',
865:                 background: 'var(--surface-elevated)',
866:                 border: '1px solid var(--border)',
867:                 color: 'var(--text-primary)',
868:                 fontSize: '0.8rem',
869:               }}
870:             >
871:               <option value="ALL">All Classifications</option>
872:               <option value="SIF_POTENTIAL">SIF Potential Only</option>
873:               <option value="NON_SIF">Non-SIF Only</option>
874:               <option value="UNCERTAIN">Uncertain Only</option>
875:             </select>
876:           </div>
877: 
878:           {/* Dataset Source Filter */}
879:           <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
880:             <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>
881:               Source:
882:             </span>
883:             <select
884:               value={sourceFilter}
885:               onChange={(e) => setSourceFilter(e.target.value)}
886:               style={{
887:                 padding: '6px 10px',
888:                 borderRadius: '7px',
889:                 background: 'var(--surface-elevated)',
890:                 border: '1px solid var(--border)',
891:                 color: 'var(--text-primary)',
892:                 fontSize: '0.8rem',
893:               }}
894:             >
895:               <option value="ALL">All Sources</option>
896:               <option value="manual">Manual Narrative</option>
897:               <option value="ocr">OCR Scan / Document</option>
898:               <option value="oil_hsse">OIL HSSE Data</option>
899:             </select>
900:           </div>
901: 
902:           {/* Facility / Site Filter */}
903:           {uniqueSites.length > 0 && (
904:             <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
905:               <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>
906:                 Site:
907:               </span>
908:               <select
909:                 value={siteFilter}
910:                 onChange={(e) => setSiteFilter(e.target.value)}
911:                 style={{
912:                   padding: '6px 10px',
913:                   borderRadius: '7px',
914:                   background: 'var(--surface-elevated)',
915:                   border: '1px solid var(--border)',
916:                   color: 'var(--text-primary)',
917:                   fontSize: '0.8rem',
918:                   maxWidth: '180px',
919:                 }}
920:               >
921:                 <option value="ALL">All Sites ({uniqueSites.length})</option>
922:                 {uniqueSites.map((site) => (
923:                   <option key={site} value={site}>
924:                     {site}
925:                   </option>
926:                 ))}
927:               </select>
928:             </div>
929:           )}
930: 
931:           {/* Hazard Type Filter */}
932:           {uniqueHazards.length > 0 && (
933:             <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
934:               <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>
935:                 Hazard:
936:               </span>
937:               <select
938:                 value={hazardFilter}
939:                 onChange={(e) => setHazardFilter(e.target.value)}
940:                 style={{
941:                   padding: '6px 10px',
942:                   borderRadius: '7px',
943:                   background: 'var(--surface-elevated)',
944:                   border: '1px solid var(--border)',
945:                   color: 'var(--text-primary)',
946:                   fontSize: '0.8rem',
947:                   maxWidth: '180px',
948:                 }}
949:               >
950:                 <option value="ALL">All Hazards ({uniqueHazards.length})</option>
951:                 {uniqueHazards.map((haz) => (
952:                   <option key={haz} value={haz}>
953:                     {haz}
954:                   </option>
955:                 ))}
956:               </select>
957:             </div>
958:           )}
959: 
960:           {/* Sort By selector */}
961:           <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px', marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
962:             <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>
963:               Sort:
964:             </span>
965:             <select
966:               value={sortBy}
967:               onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value as SortField)}
968:               style={{
969:                 padding: '6px 10px',
970:                 borderRadius: '7px',
971:                 background: 'var(--surface-elevated)',
972:                 border: '1px solid var(--border)',
973:                 color: 'var(--text-primary)',
974:                 fontSize: '0.8rem',
975:               }}
976:             >
977:               <option value="priority">Priority (Risk First)</option>
978:               <option value="confidence">SIF Confidence</option>
979:               <option value="site">Facility / Site (A-Z)</option>
980:               <option value="activity">Activity (A-Z)</option>
981:               <option value="hazard">Hazard (A-Z)</option>
982:               <option value="id">Record ID</option>
983:             </select>
984:             <button
985:               onClick={() => setSortDirection(sortDirection === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc')}
986:               className="btn btn-secondary"
987:               style={{ padding: '6px 8px', borderRadius: '7px' }}
988:               title={`Sort direction: ${sortDirection === 'asc' ? 'Ascending' : 'Descending'}`}
989:             >
990:               <ArrowUpDown size={13} />
991:             </button>
992:           </div>
993:         </div>
994: 
995:         {/* Active Filter Chips */}
996:         {activeFilters.length > 0 && (
997:           <div
998:             style={{
999:               display: 'flex',
1000:               alignItems: 'center',
1001:               gap: '8px',
1002:               flexWrap: 'wrap',
1003:               paddingTop: '8px',
1004:               borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
1005:             }}
1006:           >
1007:             <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontWeight: 700, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
1008:               Active Filters:
1009:             </span>
1010:             {activeFilters.map((f) => (
1011:               <div key={f.key} className="filter-chip">
1012:                 <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{f.label}:</span>
1013:                 <span style={{ color: 'var(--primary-bright)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{f.value}</span>
1014:                 <button onClick={f.clear} className="filter-chip-remove" title="Remove filter">
1015:                   <X size={12} />
1016:                 </button>
1017:               </div>
1018:             ))}
1019:             <button
1020:               onClick={clearAllFilters}
1021:               style={{
1022:                 background: 'transparent',
1023:                 border: 'none',
1024:                 color: 'var(--danger)',
1025:                 fontSize: '0.75rem',
1026:                 fontWeight: 600,
1027:                 cursor: 'pointer',
1028:                 padding: '2px 6px',
1029:                 fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)',
1030:               }}
1031:             >
1032:               Clear all
1033:             </button>
1034:           </div>
1035:         )}
1036:       </div>
1037: 
1038:       {error && <ErrorBanner message={error} onRetry={handleRefresh} />}
1039: 
1040:       {/* 4. Results Header & Count */}
1041:       <div
1042:         style={{
1043:           display: 'flex',
1044:           justifyContent: 'space-between',
1045:           alignItems: 'center',
1046:           padding: '0 4px',
1047:           flexWrap: 'wrap',
1048:           gap: '10px',
1049:         }}
1050:       >
1051:         <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px' }}>
1052:           <span style={{ fontSize: '0.92rem', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
1053:             {sortedReports.length.toLocaleString()} {sortedReports.length === 1 ? 'intelligence record' : 'intelligence records'}
1054:           </span>
1055:           {activeFilters.length > 0 && (
1056:             <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>
1057:               (filtered from {stats.total.toLocaleString()})
1058:             </span>
1059:           )}
1060:         </div>
1061: 
1062:         {/* Showing Range & Page Size */}
1063:         <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '14px' }}>
1064:           <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>
1065:             Showing {sortedReports.length === 0 ? 0 : (safeCurrentPage - 1) * pageSize + 1}–
1066:             {Math.min(safeCurrentPage * pageSize, sortedReports.length)} of {sortedReports.length}
1067:           </span>
1068: 
1069:           <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
1070:             <select
1071:               value={pageSize}
1072:               onChange={(e) => {
1073:                 setPageSize(Number(e.target.value));
1074:                 setCurrentPage(1);
1075:               }}
1076:               style={{
1077:                 padding: '4px 8px',
1078:                 borderRadius: '6px',
1079:                 background: 'var(--surface-elevated)',
1080:                 border: '1px solid var(--border)',
1081:                 color: 'var(--text-primary)',
1082:                 fontSize: '0.78rem',
1083:                 fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)',
1084:               }}
1085:             >
1086:               <option value={15}>15 / page</option>
1087:               <option value={25}>25 / page</option>
1088:               <option value={50}>50 / page</option>
1089:               <option value={100}>100 / page</option>
1090:             </select>
1091:           </div>
1092:         </div>
1093:       </div>
1094: 
1095:       {/* 5. Reports Table */}
1096:       {loading ? (
1097:         <LoadingSkeleton rows={8} />
1098:       ) : sortedReports.length === 0 ? (
1099:         <EmptyState
1100:           title="No Intelligence Records Found"
1101:           description="No reports match your current filter and search criteria. Try adjusting or clearing your filters."
1102:           actionLabel="Clear Filters"
1103:           onAction={clearAllFilters}
1104:         />
1105:       ) : (
1106:         <div
1107:           className="card"
1108:           style={{
1109:             overflow: 'hidden',
1110:             width: '100%',
1111:             borderRadius: '16px',
1112:             border: '1px solid var(--border)',
1113:             boxShadow: '0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)',
1114:           }}
1115:         >
1116:           <div style={{ width: '100%', overflowX: 'auto' }}>
1117:             <table className="data-table" style={{ width: '100%', minWidth: '1050px' }}>
1118:               <thead>
1119:                 <tr>
1120:                   <th style={{ width: '140px', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>Record ID</th>
1121:                   <th style={{ width: '130px', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>Source</th>
1122:                   <th style={{ minWidth: '160px', maxWidth: '220px' }}>Site / Employer</th>
1123:                   <th style={{ minWidth: '180px', maxWidth: '260px' }}>Activity / Task</th>
1124:                   <th style={{ minWidth: '160px', maxWidth: '220px' }}>Hazard</th>
1125:                   <th style={{ minWidth: '170px', maxWidth: '240px' }}>Barrier Defect</th>
1126:                   <th style={{ width: '160px', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>SIF Classification</th>
1127:                   <th style={{ width: '100px', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', textAlign: 'center' }}>Action</th>
1128:                 </tr>
1129:               </thead>
1130:               <tbody>
1131:                 {paginatedReports.map((r) => {
1132:                   const isSelected = selectedReport?.id === r.id;
1133:                   const isHighRisk =
1134:                     r.sif_potential === 'SIF_POTENTIAL' &&
1135:                     ((r.sif_confidence || r.sif_score || 0) >= 0.8 || Boolean(r.barrier_failure));
1136: 
1137:                   return (
1138:                     <tr
1139:                       key={r.id}
1140:                       onClick={() => handleOpenReport(r)}
1141:                       style={{
1142:                         height: '52px',
1143:                         background: isSelected
1144:                           ? 'rgba(255, 106, 0, 0.08)'
1145:                           : undefined,
1146:                         cursor: 'pointer',
1147:                         transition: 'background-color 0.15s ease',
1148:                       }}
1149:                       className="interactive-row"
1150:                     >
1151:                       {/* Record ID */}
1152:                       <td style={{ whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
1153:                         <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
1154:                           {isHighRisk && (
1155:                             <span
1156:                               style={{
1157:                                 width: '6px',
1158:                                 height: '6px',
1159:                                 borderRadius: '50%',
1160:                                 background: 'var(--danger)',
1161:                                 flexShrink: 0,
1162:                               }}
1163:                               title="High Priority Risk Precursor"
1164:                             />
1165:                           )}
1166:                           <span
1167:                             style={{
1168:                               fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)',
1169:                               fontSize: '0.8rem',
1170:                               color: 'var(--primary-bright)',
1171:                               fontWeight: 700,
1172:                             }}
1173:                           >
1174:                             #{r.source_record_id}
1175:                           </span>
1176:                         </div>
1177:                       </td>
1178: 
1179:                       {/* Source Dataset */}
1180:                       <td>
1181:                         {(() => {
1182:                           const orig = (r as any).data_origin || (r.source_record_id.startsWith("BFT") || r.source_record_id.startsWith("REC-BFT") ? "synthetic" : r.source_dataset);
1183:                           const isSynth = orig === "synthetic" || r.source_record_id.startsWith("BFT") || r.source_record_id.startsWith("REC-BFT");
1184:                           const isManual = orig === "manual" || r.source_record_id.startsWith("RAW");
1185:                           const isOcr = orig === "ocr" || r.source_record_id.startsWith("OCR");

- Project is "SIF-Guard": AI/NLP-powered Serious Injury & Fatality Precursor Intelligence Platform for Oil India Limited
- Backend: Python/FastAPI in `/Users/atul/develop/SIF-Guard/sif-guard/`
- Frontend: React/TypeScript in `/Users/atul/develop/SIF-Guard/sif-guard-frontend/`
- Database: SQLite (sif_guard.db), with Supabase env vars also present
- Backend uses SQLAlchemy ORM, declarative_base, SessionLocal pattern
- FastAPI app with lifespan that auto-creates tables and seeds IOGP Life-Saving Rule definitions
- API prefix from `settings.API_V1_STR` (`/api/v1`), CORS open to all origins
- Config: `pydantic_settings.BaseSettings`, env from `.env`, defaults: SQLite, `BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5` embeddings, XGBoost SIF classifier, tesseract OCR, MLflow at localhost:5000
- SIF thresholds: HIGH=0.70, UNCERTAIN=0.40; LSR_THRESHOLD=0.65; SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD=0.70
- DB Models (10): SafetyReport, ReportAnalysis, LifeSavingRule, HSEKnowledge, CatastrophicMechanism, PrecursorCluster, SIFLabel, AnalysisJob, Terminology, ModelRegistry
- SafetyReport has ~50+ columns; ReportAnalysis stores SIF classification/score/confidence, risk_factors, extraction, LSR, fingerprint as JSON
- Services architecture: extraction (rule-based barrier taxonomy), SIF classifier (XGBoost + heuristic fallback + weak rules), LSR matcher (IOGP 9 rules with keyword+embedding matching), embeddings (sentence-transformers singleton with cache), fingerprint, similarity (cosine on embeddings), clustering (HDBSCAN/KMeans), analytics, trends, preprocessing, OCR, facility (digital twin)
- OILHSSEAdapter: ingestion adapter for OIL UA/UC/Near Miss/Incident datasets
- FacilityService: 7 standardized facility zones with SVG centers, keywords, default actions; supports demo scenarios and simulation
- WeakSupervisionRules: domain-specific heuristic rules for SIF precursor detection
- ML features: 11 categorical feature columns; sklearn ColumnTransformer with OneHotEncoder
- OCR service: `OCRService` wraps `BaseOCRProvider` (abstract), default `TesseractOCRProvider`; handles image and PDF; preprocessing includes grayscale conversion + contrast enhancement; text normalization preserves HSE acronyms (LOTO, H2S, LEL, PTW, etc.)
- Frontend App.tsx: lazy-loaded pages (Dashboard, FacilityTwin, Ingestion, ReportsExplorer, PrecursorClusters, Analytics, KnowledgeLSR, ReviewQueue, DesignSystem, Landing, Auth); uses `AuthProvider`, `Header`, `Navigation`, `KeyboardShortcutsModal`
- Frontend auth: Supabase-based AuthContext with user/session/profile state, signIn/signUp/signOut
- Frontend state: Zustand `useFilterStore` with DashboardFilters (dateRange, locations, activities, hazards, barriers, sifClassification, lifeSavingRules, patterns, searchQuery)
- Frontend API client: axios-based `apiClient` at `${VITE_API_BASE_URL}/api/v1`, 30s timeout, error interceptor
- Frontend API modules: `reports.ts` (import, list, get, analyze, analyzeBatch, getJobStatus), `analytics.ts` (sites, activities, hazards, barriers, lsr, trends, dashboardSummary), `health.ts` (checkSystemHealth), `lsr.ts` (getLSRRules, mapTextToLSR), `knowledge.ts` (searchKnowledge), `review.ts` (getReviewQueue, submitReview), `patterns.ts` (getClusters, triggerClustering, getSimilarReports), `ocr.ts` (extractDocumentOCR with normalized response), `facility.ts` (getFacilityOverview, getZoneDetails, getDemoScenarios, simulateDemoIncident, resetDemoData)
- Frontend pages (10): DashboardPage (KPI strip, trend/barrier/heatmap/SIF charts, activity feed, executive insights), LandingPage (3D refinery canvas, fallback zones, theme toggle, smooth scroll animations), IngestionPage (multi-source: pdf/image/camera/manual/structured, OCR workflow with 4 steps, analysis display), ReportsExplorerPage (list/filter/sort/analyze/similar reports, pagination), AnalyticsPage (6 dimension tabs: sites/activities/hazards/barriers/lsr/trends), FacilityTwinPage (3D/2D view toggle, zone detail drawer, demo simulation modal, live activity timeline), PrecursorClustersPage (fetch/trigger HDBSCAN clustering), KnowledgeLSRPage (LSR rules list, text mapping sandbox, knowledge search), ReviewQueuePage (queue with review modal, label/confidence/comments submission), DesignSystemPage (color swatches, typography, component showcase)

48:   'struck by',
49:   'explosion',
50:   'hydrocarbon',
51:   'flange',
52:   'valve',
53:   'breathing apparatus',
54: ];
55: 
56: export const EvidenceHighlighter: React.FC<EvidenceHighlighterProps> = ({
57:   text,
58:   riskFactors = [],
59:   energySource,
60:   barrierFailure,
61:   hazard,
62:   className = '',
63:   style = {},
64: }) => {
65:   if (!text) return <span>-</span>;
66: 
67:   // Compile keywords list
68:   const targetPhrases = new Set<string>();
69: 
70:   // Add risk factors passed from AI / extraction
71:   riskFactors.forEach((rf) => {
72:     if (rf && rf.trim().length > 2) targetPhrases.add(rf.trim().toLowerCase());
73:   });
74: 
75:   if (energySource && energySource.trim().length > 2) {
76:     targetPhrases.add(energySource.trim().toLowerCase());
77:   }
78:   if (barrierFailure && barrierFailure.trim().length > 2) {
79:     targetPhrases.add(barrierFailure.trim().toLowerCase());
80:   }
81:   if (hazard && hazard.trim().length > 2) {
82:     targetPhrases.add(hazard.trim().toLowerCase());
83:   }
84: 
85:   // Add defaults
86:   DEFAULT_RISK_KEYWORDS.forEach((kw) => {
87:     if (text.toLowerCase().includes(kw)) {
88:       targetPhrases.add(kw);
89:     }
90:   });
91: 
92:   if (targetPhrases.size === 0) {
93:     return <span className={className} style={style}>{text}</span>;
94:   }
95: 
96:   // Sort phrases by length descending to match longest phrases first
97:   const sortedPhrases = Array.from(targetPhrases).sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);
98: 
99:   // Build regex pattern safely
100:   const escapedPhrases = sortedPhrases.map((p) => p.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'));
101:   const regex = new RegExp(`(${escapedPhrases.join('|')})`, 'gi');
102: 
103:   const parts = text.split(regex);
104: 
105:   return (
106:     <span className={className} style={{ lineHeight: 1.6, ...style }}>
107:       {parts.map((part, index) => {
108:         const lowerPart = part.toLowerCase();
109:         const isMatch = sortedPhrases.some((phrase) => phrase === lowerPart || lowerPart.includes(phrase));
110: 
111:         if (isMatch) {
112:           const isCritical =
113:             lowerPart.includes('without') ||
114:             lowerPart.includes('no ') ||
115:             lowerPart.includes('dropped') ||
116:             lowerPart.includes('fell') ||
117:             lowerPart.includes('pressure') ||
118:             lowerPart.includes('h2s') ||
119:             lowerPart.includes('energized') ||
120:             lowerPart.includes('bypass');
121: 
122:           return (
123:             <mark
124:               key={index}
125:               style={{
126:                 backgroundColor: isCritical
127:                   ? 'rgba(232, 93, 93, 0.18)'
128:                   : 'rgba(235, 160, 54, 0.18)',
129:                 color: isCritical ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--warning)',
130:                 padding: '2px 6px',
131:                 borderRadius: '4px',

133:                 borderBottom: `2px solid ${isCritical ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--warning)'}`,
134:                 margin: '0 1px',
135:                 fontFamily: 'inherit',
136:               }}
137:               title={`Evidence token: ${part}`}
138:             >
139:               {part}
140:             </mark>
141:           );
142:         }
143: 
144:         return <React.Fragment key={index}>{part}</React.Fragment>;

13: /**
14:  * Editorial Staggered Text Reveal inspired by React Bits Pro.
15:  * Uses a slow, deliberate line-by-line reveal with blur clearance and vertical translation.
16:  * Runs strictly once on mount.
17:  */
18: export const StaggeredText: React.FC<StaggeredTextProps> = ({
19:   lines,
20:   as: Component = 'h1',
21:   className = '',
22:   style = {},
23:   lineStyles,
24:   delayMs = 150,
25:   staggerMs = 120,
26: }) => {
27:   const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
28:   const [prefersReducedMotion, setPrefersReducedMotion] = useState(false);
29: 
30:   useEffect(() => {
31:     const isReduced =
32:       typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
33:       window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
34:     setPrefersReducedMotion(isReduced);
35: 
36:     const timer = setTimeout(() => {
37:       setMounted(true);
38:     }, delayMs);
39: 
40:     return () => clearTimeout(timer);
41:   }, [delayMs]);
42: 
43:   return (
44:     <Component className={className} style={{ ...style, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
45:       {lines.map((line, idx) => {
46:         const isRevealed = mounted || prefersReducedMotion;
47:         const lineDelay = prefersReducedMotion ? 0 : idx * staggerMs;
48:         const customLineStyle = lineStyles ? lineStyles(idx) : {};
49: 
50:         return (
51:           <span
52:             key={idx}
53:             style={{
54:               display: 'block',
55:               opacity: isRevealed ? 1 : 0,
56:               transform: isRevealed
57:                 ? 'translateY(0)'
58:                 : 'translateY(36px)',

60:               transition: prefersReducedMotion
61:                 ? 'none'
62:                 : `opacity 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) ${lineDelay}ms, transform 0.95s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) ${lineDelay}ms, filter 0.85s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) ${lineDelay}ms`,
63:               willChange: isRevealed ? 'auto' : 'transform, opacity, filter',
64:               ...customLineStyle,

13: /**
14:  * Unified Scroll Reveal Component inspired by React Bits Pro.
15:  * Reveals content deliberately upon entering the viewport with blur clearance and smooth translation.
16:  */
17: export const ScrollReveal: React.FC<ScrollRevealProps> = ({
18:   children,
19:   delayMs = 0,
20:   threshold = 0.12,
21:   className = '',
22:   style = {},
23:   direction = 'up',
24:   distance = 36,
25: }) => {
26:   const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
27:   const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
28: 
29:   useEffect(() => {
30:     const el = containerRef.current;
31:     if (!el) return;
32: 
33:     const prefersReducedMotion =
34:       typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
35:       window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
36: 
37:     if (prefersReducedMotion) {
38:       setIsVisible(true);
39:       return;
40:     }
41: 
42:     const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
43:       ([entry]) => {
44:         if (entry.isIntersecting) {
45:           setIsVisible(true);
46:           observer.disconnect();
47:         }
48:       },
49:       { threshold, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' }
50:     );
51: 
52:     observer.observe(el);
53: 
54:     return () => observer.disconnect();
55:   }, [threshold]);
56: 
57:   const translateY = direction === 'up' ? distance : direction === 'down' ? -distance : 0;
58: 
59:   return (
60:     <div
61:       ref={containerRef}
62:       className={className}
63:       style={{
64:         opacity: isVisible ? 1 : 0,
65:         transform: isVisible ? 'translateY(0)' : `translateY(${translateY}px)`,

28: /**

32:  * - Damped mouse parallax running in pure RAF.

35:  */
36: export const AmbientTelemetryCanvas: React.FC<AmbientTelemetryCanvasProps> = ({ theme = 'dark' }) => {

38:   const themeRef = useRef<'light' | 'dark'>(theme);

40:   useEffect(() => {
41:     themeRef.current = theme;
42:   }, [theme]);
43: 
44:   useEffect(() => {
45:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
46:     if (!canvas) return;
47:     const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

58:       height = window.innerHeight;
59:       if (!canvas) return;
60:       canvas.width = Math.floor(width * dpr);
61:       canvas.height = Math.floor(height * dpr);
62:       ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
63:     };
64: 
65:     updateCanvasSize();
66: 
67:     const prefersReducedMotion =
68:       typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
69:       window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
70: 
71:     // Mouse tracking for subtle parallax
72:     let targetMouseX = width * 0.5;
73:     let targetMouseY = height * 0.5;
74:     let mouseX = targetMouseX;
75:     let mouseY = targetMouseY;
76:

80:     };

84:     };
85: 
86:     window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove, { passive: true });

88: 
89:     // Initialize Neural Float Particles (~56 nodes, 15% orange, 85% warm silver)
90:     const particleCount = 56;
91:     const particles: Particle[] = [];
92:

95:       const randR = Math.random();

100:         vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.14,
101:         vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.14 - 0.03, // slight upward rising bias

119:       const isLight = themeRef.current === 'light';
120:       ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

125:       ctx.font = '9px monospace';
126:       for (let x = gridStep; x < width; x += gridStep) {

175:           ctx.fillText('+', drawGX - 3, drawGY + 3);
176:         }
177:       }
178: 
179:       // 2. Draw Twilight Telemetry Streams
180:       for (let s = 0; s < twilightStreams.length; s++) {
181:         const stream = twilightStreams[s];
182:         stream.phase += stream.speed;
183: 
184:         ctx.beginPath();
185:         const baseY = height * stream.yRatio + mouseNormY * 0.4;
186:         ctx.moveTo(0, baseY + Math.sin(stream.phase) * stream.amplitude);
187: 
188:         for (let x = 0; x < width; x += 30) {
189:           const y = baseY + Math.sin(x * stream.frequency + stream.phase) * stream.amplitude;
190:           ctx.lineTo(x, y);
191:         }
192: 
193:         if (isLight) {
194:           ctx.strokeStyle = stream.isOrange
195:             ? 'rgba(230, 95, 0, 0.04)'
196:             : 'rgba(50, 42, 34, 0.03)';
197:         } else {
198:           ctx.strokeStyle = stream.isOrange
199:             ? 'rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.06)'
200:             : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025)';
201:         }
202:         ctx.lineWidth = 1;
203:         ctx.stroke();
204:       }
205: 
206:       // 3. Draw Neural Float Particles & Connecting Lines
207:       for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
208:         const p = particles[i];
209: 
210:         // Drift
211:         p.x += p.vx;
212:         p.y += p.vy;
213:         p.pulsePhase += p.pulseSpeed;
214: 
215:         // Wrap edges with rising bias
216:         if (p.x < -15) p.x = width + 15;
217:         if (p.x > width + 15) p.x = -15;
218:         if (p.y < -15) p.y = height + 15;
219:         if (p.y > height + 15) p.y = -15;
220: 
221:         // Parallax displacement
222:         const drawX = p.x + mouseNormX * (p.radius * 0.35);
223:         const drawY = p.y + mouseNormY * (p.radius * 0.35);
224: 
225:         // Alpha calculation (base 0.16-0.38, max pulse 0.45)
226:         const pulse = Math.sin(p.pulsePhase) * 0.05;
227:         const alpha = Math.max(0.12, Math.min(0.45, p.baseAlpha + pulse));
228: 
229:         // Node render (optimized without expensive canvas context save/restore and shadowBlur)
230:         if (!isLight && p.isOrange) {
231:           ctx.beginPath();
232:           ctx.arc(drawX, drawY, p.radius * 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
233:           ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 125, 10, ${alpha * 0.25})`;
234:           ctx.fill();
235:         }
236: 
237:         ctx.beginPath();
238:         ctx.arc(drawX, drawY, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
239:         if (isLight) {
240:           ctx.fillStyle = p.isOrange
241:             ? `rgba(230, 95, 0, ${alpha * 0.85})`
242:             : `rgba(90, 80, 72, ${alpha * 0.55})`;
243:         } else {
244:           ctx.fillStyle = p.isOrange
245:             ? `rgba(255, 125, 10, ${alpha * 0.95})`
246:             : `rgba(180, 172, 164, ${alpha * 0.65})`;
247:         }
248:         ctx.fill();
249: 
250:         // Connect with nearby particles if distance < 115px (alpha 0.05 - 0.12)
251:         for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
252:           const p2 = particles[j];
253:           const dx = p.x - p2.x;
254:           const dy = p.y - p2.y;
255:           const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
256: 
257:           if (distSq < 13225) {
258:             // < 115px
259:             const dist = Math.sqrt(distSq);
260:             const lineAlpha = (1 - dist / 115);
261:             ctx.beginPath();
262:             ctx.moveTo(drawX, drawY);
263:             ctx.lineTo(
264:               p2.x + mouseNormX * (p2.radius * 0.35),
265:               p2.y + mouseNormY * (p2.radius * 0.35)
266:             );
267:             if (isLight) {
268:               ctx.strokeStyle = p.isOrange || p2.isOrange
269:                 ? `rgba(230, 95, 0, ${lineAlpha * 0.10})`
270:                 : `rgba(100, 90, 80, ${lineAlpha * 0.05})`;
271:             } else {
272:               ctx.strokeStyle = p.isOrange || p2.isOrange
273:                 ? `rgba(255, 125, 10, ${lineAlpha * 0.12})`
274:                 : `rgba(210, 202, 194, ${lineAlpha * 0.05})`;
275:             }
276:             ctx.lineWidth = p.isOrange || p2.isOrange ? 0.75 : 0.55;
277:             ctx.stroke();
278:           }
279:         }
280:       }
281:     };

283:     const handleVisibilityChange = () => {
284:       if (!document.hidden && !animId) {

298:   }, []);

300:   return (

12: /**
13:  * Subtle Hardware-Inspired Parallax Card.
14:  * Gently translates 2-4px with an internal specular gradient following cursor movement.
15:  */
16: export const ParallaxCard: React.FC<ParallaxCardProps> = ({
17:   children,
18:   className = '',
19:   style = {},
20:   onClick,
21:   theme = 'dark',
22:   glowColor,
23: }) => {
24:   const cardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
25:   const [offset, setOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
26:   const [lightPos, setLightPos] = useState({ x: 50, y: 50 });
27:   const [isHovered, setIsHovered] = useState(false);
28: 
29:   const isLight = theme === 'light';
30:   const effectiveGlow = glowColor || (isLight ? 'rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.08)' : 'rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.14)');
31: 
32:   const handleMouseMove = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
33:     if (!cardRef.current) return;
34:     const rect = cardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
35:     const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
36:     const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
37: 
38:     // Percent for specular highlight
39:     const pctX = (x / rect.width) * 100;
40:     const pctY = (y / rect.height) * 100;
41:     setLightPos({ x: pctX, y: pctY });
42: 
43:     // Subtle 2-4px translation
44:     const centerX = rect.width / 2;
45:     const centerY = rect.height / 2;
46:     const maxShift = 3;
47:     const shiftX = Math.max(-maxShift, Math.min(maxShift, (x - centerX) * 0.025));
48:     const shiftY = Math.max(-maxShift, Math.min(maxShift, (y - centerY) * 0.025));
49: 
50:     setOffset({ x: shiftX, y: shiftY });
51:   }, []);
52: 
53:   const handleMouseEnter = () => {
54:     setIsHovered(true);
55:   };
56: 
57:   const handleMouseLeave = () => {
58:     setIsHovered(false);
59:     setOffset({ x: 0, y: 0 });
60:   };
61: 
62:   return (
63:     <div
64:       ref={cardRef}
65:       onClick={onClick}
66:       onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
67:       onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}
68:       onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
69:       className={className}
70:       style={{
71:         position: 'relative',
72:         transform: `translate3d(${offset.x}px, ${offset.y}px, 0)`,
73:         transition: isHovered

75:           : 'transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease',

87:           opacity: isHovered ? 1 : 0,
88:           transition: 'opacity 0.35s ease',

1: import React, { useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
2: 
3: interface MagneticButtonProps {
4:   children: React.ReactNode;
5:   icon?: React.ReactNode;
6:   onClick?: () => void;
7:   variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary';
8:   className?: string;
9:   style?: React.CSSProperties;
10:   theme?: 'dark' | 'light';
11: }
12: 
13: /**
14:  * Subtle Magnetic Button inspired by React Bits Pro.
15:  * Pulls gently 2-4px towards cursor with independent icon shift and specular border highlight.
16:  * Free of exaggerated spring wobbles.
17:  */
18: export const MagneticButton: React.FC<MagneticButtonProps> = ({
19:   children,
20:   icon,
21:   onClick,
22:   variant = 'primary',
23:   className = '',
24:   style = {},
25:   theme = 'dark',
26: }) => {
27:   const btnRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
28:   const [offset, setOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
29:   const [isHovered, setIsHovered] = useState(false);
30:   const isLight = theme === 'light';
31: 
32:   const handleMouseMove = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
33:     if (!btnRef.current) return;
34:     const rect = btnRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
35:     const centerX = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
36:     const centerY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
37: 
38:     // Subtle 2-4px magnetic translation
39:     const maxPull = 3.5;
40:     const pullX = Math.max(-maxPull, Math.min(maxPull, (e.clientX - centerX) * 0.08));
41:     const pullY = Math.max(-maxPull, Math.min(maxPull, (e.clientY - centerY) * 0.08));
42: 
43:     setOffset({ x: pullX, y: pullY });
44:   }, []);
45: 
46:   const handleMouseEnter = () => {
47:     setIsHovered(true);
48:   };
49: 
50:   const handleMouseLeave = () => {
51:     setIsHovered(false);
52:     setOffset({ x: 0, y: 0 });
53:   };
54: 
55:   const isPrimary = variant === 'primary';
56: 
57:   const baseStyles: React.CSSProperties = isPrimary
58:     ? {
59:         backgroundColor: isHovered ? '#FF8A2A' : '#FF7300',
60:         color: '#FFFFFF',
61:         border: '1px solid rgba(255, 138, 42, 0.45)',
62:         boxShadow: isHovered
63:           ? '0 6px 24px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.35)'
64:           : '0 4px 16px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.22)',
65:       }
66:     : {
67:         backgroundColor: isLight
68:           ? isHovered
69:             ? '#FFFFFF'
70:             : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92)'
71:           : isHovered
72:             ? 'rgba(23, 20, 17, 0.95)'
73:             : 'rgba(18, 16, 14, 0.85)',
74:         color: isLight ? '#1C1815' : '#F5F1EA',
75:         border: isHovered
76:           ? '1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.5)'
77:           : isLight
78:             ? '1px solid rgba(195, 182, 168, 0.75)'
79:             : '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)',
80:         boxShadow: isHovered
81:           ? isLight
82:             ? '0 6px 20px rgba(40, 30, 20, 0.08)'
83:             : '0 6px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)'
84:           : 'none',
85:       };
86: 
87:   return (
88:     <button
89:       ref={btnRef}
90:       onClick={onClick}
91:       onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
92:       onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}
93:       onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
94:       className={className}
95:       style={{
96:         display: 'inline-flex',
97:         alignItems: 'center',
98:         justifyContent: 'center',
99:         gap: '9px',
100:         padding: isPrimary ? '13px 28px' : '13px 26px',
101:         borderRadius: '10px',
102:         fontSize: '0.94rem',
103:         fontWeight: 600,
104:         cursor: 'pointer',
105:         backdropFilter: 'blur(10px)',
106:         WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(10px)',
107:         transform: `translate3d(${offset.x}px, ${offset.y}px, 0)`,
108:         transition: isHovered
109:           ? 'transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease'
110:           : 'transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease',
111:         willChange: 'transform',
112:         ...baseStyles,
113:         ...style,
114:       }}
115:     >
116:       <span>{children}</span>
117:       {icon && (
118:         <span
119:           style={{
120:             display: 'inline-flex',
121:             alignItems: 'center',
122:             transform: `translate3d(${offset.x * 0.4}px, ${offset.y * 0.4}px, 0)`,
123:             transition: isHovered
124:               ? 'transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1)'
125:               : 'transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)',
126:           }}
127:         >
128:           {icon}
129:         </span>
130:       )}
131:     </button>
132:   );
133: };

554:       interactiveMeshesRef.current.push(...interactiveMeshes);
555:     } else {
556:       zoneEntriesRef.current = [];
557:     }
558: 
559:     // Create & Add Incidents
560:     if (layers.incidents) {
561:       const { incidentGroup, entries, interactiveMeshes } = createIncidentMarkers(
562:         activeIncidents,
563:         selectedZoneIdRef.current
564:       );
565:       incidentGroup.name = 'INCIDENT_GROUP';
566:       scene.add(incidentGroup);
567:       incidentEntriesRef.current = entries;
568:       interactiveMeshesRef.current.push(...interactiveMeshes);
569:     } else {
570:       incidentEntriesRef.current = [];
571:     }
572:   }, [zones, activeIncidents, layers.riskZones, layers.incidents, layers.labels, minimalOverlay]);
573: 
574:   // Synchronize selection / hover highlighting without rebuilding meshes
575:   useEffect(() => {
576:     selectedZoneIdRef.current = selectedZoneId;
577:     hoveredZoneIdRef.current = hoveredZoneId;
578:     updateZoneHighlight(hoveredZoneId, selectedZoneId);
579:   }, [hoveredZoneId, selectedZoneId, updateZoneHighlight]);
580: 
581:   // Sync camera when selectedZoneId changes externally (Only in full dashboard mode)
582:   useEffect(() => {
583:     if (selectedZoneId && !minimalOverlay) {
584:       const cfg = ZONE_3D_CONFIGS[selectedZoneId];
585:       if (cfg) {
586:         targetCamPos.current.set(...cfg.cameraFocus.position);
587:         targetLookAt.current.set(...cfg.cameraFocus.target);
588:         isAnimatingCam.current = true;
589:         setActivePreset(selectedZoneId);
590:       }
591:     }
592:   }, [selectedZoneId, minimalOverlay]);
593: 
594:   // Process raycasting hover via requestAnimationFrame
595:   const processHover = useCallback(() => {
596:     rafHoverIdRef.current = null;
597:     if (isDraggingRef.current) return;
598:     if (!pointerPosRef.current) return;
599: 
600:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
601:     const camera = cameraRef.current;
602:     if (!canvas || !camera) return;
603: 
604:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
605:     const { clientX, clientY } = pointerPosRef.current;
606:     const mouseX = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
607:     const mouseY = -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
608: 
609:     raycasterRef.current.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(mouseX, mouseY), camera);
610:     const intersects = raycasterRef.current.intersectObjects(interactiveMeshesRef.current, false);
611: 
612:     if (intersects.length > 0) {
613:       const topHit = intersects[0].object;
614:       const userData = topHit.userData;
615:       const hitZoneId = (userData.zoneId as string) || null;
616: 
617:       const posX = clientX - rect.left;
618:       const posY = clientY - rect.top;
619: 
620:       // Update tooltip position immediately on DOM element without React re-render
621:       if (tooltipRef.current) {
622:         const maxX = Math.max(100, rect.width - 295);
623:         const maxY = Math.max(100, rect.height - 180);
624:         tooltipRef.current.style.transform = `translate(${Math.min(Math.max(10, posX + 16), maxX)}px, ${Math.min(Math.max(10, posY + 16), maxY)}px)`;
625:       }
626: 
627:       // Only update state & notify parent when the hovered zone actually changes
628:       if (hitZoneId !== hoveredZoneIdRef.current) {
629:         hoveredZoneIdRef.current = hitZoneId;
630:         onHoverZone(hitZoneId);
631:         updateZoneHighlight(hitZoneId, selectedZoneIdRef.current);
632: 
633:         if (userData.type === 'zone') {
634:           setHoveredData({
635:             type: 'zone',
636:             data: userData.zone,
637:             x: posX,
638:             y: posY,
639:           });
640:         } else if (userData.type === 'incident') {
641:           setHoveredData({
642:             type: 'incident',
643:             data: userData.incident,
644:             x: posX,
645:             y: posY,
646:           });
647:         }
648:       }
649:     } else {
650:       if (hoveredZoneIdRef.current !== null) {
651:         hoveredZoneIdRef.current = null;
652:         onHoverZone(null);
653:         setHoveredData(null);
654:         updateZoneHighlight(null, selectedZoneIdRef.current);
655:       }
656:     }
657:   }, [onHoverZone, updateZoneHighlight]);
658: 
659:   const handlePointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
660:     dragStartPos.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
661:     isDraggingRef.current = false;
662:     isAnimatingCam.current = false;
663:   };
664: 
665:   const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
666:     // If mouse button is held and moved > 4px, user is in active OrbitControls drag
667:     if (e.buttons > 0) {
668:       const dist = Math.hypot(e.clientX - dragStartPos.current.x, e.clientY - dragStartPos.current.y);
669:       if (dist > 4) {
670:         isDraggingRef.current = true;
671:         if (hoveredData) {
672:           setHoveredData(null);
673:         }
674:         return;
675:       }
676:     }
677: 
678:     pointerPosRef.current = { clientX: e.clientX, clientY: e.clientY };
679:     if (rafHoverIdRef.current === null) {
680:       rafHoverIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(processHover);
681:     }
682:   };
683: 
684:   const handleCanvasClick = (clientX: number, clientY: number) => {
685:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
686:     const camera = cameraRef.current;
687:     if (!canvas || !camera) return;
688: 
689:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
690:     const mouseX = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
691:     const mouseY = -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
692: 
693:     raycasterRef.current.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(mouseX, mouseY), camera);
694:     const intersects = raycasterRef.current.intersectObjects(interactiveMeshesRef.current, false);
695: 
696:     if (intersects.length > 0) {
697:       const topHit = intersects[0].object;
698:       const userData = topHit.userData;
699: 
700:       if (userData.type === 'zone') {
701:         onSelectZone(userData.zoneId);
702:       } else if (userData.type === 'incident') {
703:         onSelectZone(userData.zoneId);
704:         if (onSelectIncident) {
705:           onSelectIncident(userData.incident);
706:         }
707:       }
708:     }
709:   };
710: 
711:   const handlePointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
712:     const dist = Math.hypot(e.clientX - dragStartPos.current.x, e.clientY - dragStartPos.current.y);
713:     if (dist <= 4 && !isDraggingRef.current) {
714:       handleCanvasClick(e.clientX, e.clientY);
715:     }
716:     setTimeout(() => {
717:       isDraggingRef.current = false;
718:       pointerPosRef.current = { clientX: e.clientX, clientY: e.clientY };
719:       if (rafHoverIdRef.current === null) {
720:         rafHoverIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(processHover);
721:       }
722:     }, 50);
723:   };
724: 
725:   const handlePointerLeave = () => {
726:     if (rafHoverIdRef.current !== null) {
727:       cancelAnimationFrame(rafHoverIdRef.current);
728:       rafHoverIdRef.current = null;
729:     }
730:     pointerPosRef.current = null;
731:     if (hoveredZoneIdRef.current !== null) {
732:       hoveredZoneIdRef.current = null;
733:       onHoverZone(null);
734:       setHoveredData(null);
735:       updateZoneHighlight(null, selectedZoneIdRef.current);
736:     }
737:   };

742:       <div

783:           >
784:             <MapPin size={16} /> Switch to 2D Spatial Map

819:         onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
820:         onPointerLeave={handlePointerLeave}
821:         style={{
822:           width: '100%',

904:                     </span>

## 1. `/Users/atul/develop/SIF-Guard/sif-guard/scripts/train_sif_model.py` (145 lines)

**What it does:** Trains an XGBoost binary classifier to predict SIF (Serious Injury or Fatality) potential from safety reports stored in the database. It uses weak supervision labels as ground truth and combines text embeddings with structured features as the input feature vector.

**Key function:**
- `train_model()` -- The sole function. Orchestrates the entire training pipeline.

**CLI arguments:** None. Run directly via `python train_sif_model.py`.

**Database operations:**
- **Read:** Queries all `SafetyReport` records from the database.
- **Write:** After training, creates or updates a `ModelRegistry` record with the model name `"sif-xgboost-v1"`, storing evaluation metrics and marking the model as active.

**Important logic:**
1. For each report, it runs `extraction_service.extract()` to get structured fields, retrieves or generates an embedding via `embedding_service.encode()`, and extracts structured features via `sif_classifier.extract_structured_features()`.
2. The feature vector is the concatenation of the embedding and structured features.
3. Labels come from `weak_rules_engine.evaluate()`: `"SIF_POTENTIAL"` maps to label 1, `"NON_SIF"` maps to label 0; uncertain results are skipped entirely.
4. Requires at least 10 labeled samples to proceed with training.
5. Uses an 80/20 stratified train/test split.
6. XGBoost parameters: `binary:logistic` objective, `max_depth=5`, `eta=0.1`, `subsample=0.8`, 100 boosting rounds.
7. Evaluation metrics: Precision, Recall, F1, ROC-AUC, and PR-AUC.
8. The trained model is saved to `sif_classifier.model_path`.
9. Gracefully handles the case where `xgboost` is not installed (`HAS_XGB` flag).

---

  - `LifeSavingRule` -- Populated from `IOGP_LSR_DEFINITIONS` (imported from the LSR matcher service). Each rule gets an id like `"lsr_{code}"`, with code, name, description, and keywords.
  - `Terminology` -- Populated from `DEFAULT_TERMINOLOGY` (imported from the preprocessing cleaner). Each entry gets an id like `"term_{term.lower()}"`, with term, expansion, and category `"general_hse"`.

## 4. `/Users/atul/develop/SIF-Guard/sif-guard/scripts/generate_sif_dataset.py` (421 lines)

**What it does:** Generates a synthetic labeled dataset for training the SIF XGBoost classifier. Produces 5,000 records by default, including 500 counterfactual pairs (a high-risk SIF record paired with a safe "same-scenario-but-barriers-in-place" record), plus additional random records. Outputs CSV files split into train/validation/test sets.

**Key function:**
- `generate_dataset(total_records=5000)` -- Generates the entire dataset and writes CSV files.

**CLI arguments:** None. Hardcoded to 5000 records at invocation.

**Database operations:** None. This is a pure data generation script that writes CSV files to disk.

**Important logic:**
1. **9 HIGH_RISK_PATTERNS** defined inline, covering: pressurized system maintenance (2 variants), confined space entry, work at height, machinery/grinding, lifting operations, hot work, excavation, and vehicle-pedestrian interaction. Each pattern has full structured fields (activity, hazard, substance, exposure, energy source, equipment, human/environmental factors, barrier, barrier failure, consequence, SIF reason) plus "safe" counterparts for counterfactual generation.
2. **6 LOW_RISK_PATTERNS** defined inline: office housekeeping, routine tool inspection, pressurized system maintenance (with proper LOTO), work at height (with proper harness), confined space entry (with proper gas testing), and lifting operation (with proper barricading). All have `sif_potential=0` and `barrier_failure="none"`.
3. **Counterfactual pairs (500 pairs = 1000 records):** For each pair, one SIF-positive record is generated from a random high-risk pattern, and one SIF-negative record is generated from the same pattern but with the safe barrier/exposure fields. Both share a `pair_id`.
4. **Remaining records (4000):** 35% chance of being SIF-positive (from high-risk patterns), 65% chance of being SIF-negative (from low-risk patterns). These have `pair_id="none"`.
5. **Train/Val/Test split (70/15/15):** Counterfactual pairs are split by pair_id (ensuring both members of a pair go to the same split). Non-pair records are split with stratification on `sif_potential`. Both splits are then concatenated and shuffled.
6. **Output files:**
   - `data/sif_guard_xgboost_dataset.csv` (full dataset)
   - `data/sif_guard_train.csv` (70%)
   - `data/sif_guard_validation.csv` (15%)
   - `data/sif_guard_test.csv` (15%)

---

## 5. `/Users/atul/develop/SIF-Guard/sif-guard/scripts/train_sif_xgboost.py` (230 lines)

**What it does:** The offline XGBoost classifier training pipeline. Reads the pre-generated CSV datasets, fits a OneHotEncoder preprocessor on categorical features, trains an XGBClassifier with early stopping, evaluates on a held-out test set (including counterfactual pair accuracy), and persists all model artifacts to disk.

**Key function:**
- `train_sif_xgboost()` -- Complete training pipeline from data loading through artifact persistence.

**CLI arguments:** None. Run directly via `python train_sif_xgboost.py`.

**Database operations:** None. Reads CSV files and writes model artifacts to disk only.

**Important logic:**
1. If the training CSV does not exist, it auto-invokes `generate_sif_dataset.generate_dataset(5000)` to create it.
2. Loads train/validation/test CSVs, fills missing values with `DEFAULT_MISSING_VALUE`.
3. Validates that all columns in `SIF_FEATURE_COLUMNS` and the target column `"sif_potential"` exist.
4. Fits the OneHotEncoder preprocessor **strictly on training data** (preventing data leakage), then transforms all three splits.
5. **XGBClassifier hyperparameters:** 300 estimators, `max_depth=4`, `learning_rate=0.05`, `subsample=0.8`, `colsample_bytree=0.8`, `binary:logistic` objective, `logloss` eval metric, early stopping after 30 rounds without improvement.
6. **Test evaluation metrics:** Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, full confusion matrix (TP/TN/FP/FN), and False Negative Rate.
7. **Counterfactual pair accuracy:** For each counterfactual pair in the test set, checks whether the SIF-positive member gets a higher predicted probability than the safe member.
8. **5 artifacts saved to `app/ml/models/sif/`:**
   - `xgboost_model.json` -- The XGBoost model.
   - `preprocessor.joblib` -- The fitted sklearn preprocessor.
   - `feature_schema.json` -- Feature column names, target name, missing value strategy.
   - `metrics.json` -- All evaluation metrics including counterfactual pair accuracy.
   - `model_metadata.json` -- Model type, version, timestamp, dataset sizes, XGBoost version, encoded feature count, operating thresholds (`SIF_HIGH_THRESHOLD`, `SIF_UNCERTAIN_THRESHOLD`), and a warning that this is trained on synthetic data.

**What it does:** Cleans up synthetic/test records from the database (those with IDs starting with `"BFT-"` or `"REC-BFT-"`, or with site `"Test Facility"`), performs a schema migration to add a `data_origin` column, and assigns origin labels to remaining records.

398: .btn-primary {

405: .btn-primary:hover {

428: }
429:

435: }
436: 
437: .btn-danger:hover {

440:   box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(232, 93, 93, 0.35);
441: }
442: 
443: .btn-ghost {

454: /* ==========================================================================
455:    INPUTS & FORM CONTROLS
456:    ========================================================================== */
457: 
458: input[type="text"],
459: input[type="number"],
460: input[type="search"],
461: select,
462: textarea {
463:   background-color: var(--background-secondary) !important;
464:   color: var(--text-primary) !important;

466:   border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
467:   padding: 10px 14px;
468:   font-size: 0.875rem;
469:   font-family: var(--font-main);
470:   transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
471: }
472: 
473: [data-theme="light"] input[type="text"],
474: [data-theme="light"] input[type="number"],
475: [data-theme="light"] input[type="search"],
476: [data-theme="light"] select,
477: [data-theme="light"] textarea {
478:   background-color: #FFFFFF !important;
479:   border: 1px solid var(--border) !important;

482: input[type="text"]:focus,
483: input[type="number"]:focus,
484: input[type="search"]:focus,

539: /* ==========================================================================
540:    DATA TABLES
541:    ========================================================================== */
542: 
543: .data-table {

546:   text-align: left;
547:   font-size: 0.875rem;
548:   background: transparent;
549: }
550: 
551: .data-table th {

558:   font-size: 0.72rem;

588: /* ==========================================================================
589:    MODAL & OVERLAYS
590:    ========================================================================== */
591:

746: /* ==========================================================================
747:    CINEMATIC INDUSTRIAL LANDING PAGE UTILITIES
748:    ========================================================================== */
749: 
750: .bg-micro-grid {
751:   background-image: 
752:     linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) 1px, transparent 1px),
753:     linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) 1px, transparent 1px);
754:   background-size: 48px 48px;

759:     linear-gradient(to right, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
760:     linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
761: }
762: 
763: .telemetry-hud-container {
764:   display: flex;
765:   align-items: center;
766:   justify-content: center;
767:   flex-wrap: wrap;
768:   gap: 14px 28px;
769:   width: min(1200px, 88vw);
770:   min-height: 48px;
771:   padding: 8px 24px;
772:   border-radius: 8px;
773:   background: rgba(18, 16, 14, 0.65);
774:   border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
775:   backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
776:   -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
777:   font-family: var(--font-mono);
778:   font-size: 0.75rem;
779:   letter-spacing: 0.04em;
780:   box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
781:   position: relative;
782:   overflow: hidden;
783: }
784: 
785: [data-theme="light"] .telemetry-hud-container {
786:   border-radius: 8px;
787:   background: rgba(250, 248, 245, 0.85);
788:   border: 1px solid rgba(195, 182, 168, 0.45);
789:   box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(40, 30, 20, 0.04);
790: }
791: 
792: .telemetry-hud-container::before {
793:   content: '';
794:   position: absolute;
795:   top: 0;
796:   left: -100%;
797:   width: 50%;
798:   height: 100%;
799:   background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.08), transparent);
800:   animation: telemetry-sweep 6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
801:   pointer-events: none;
802: }
803: 
804: @keyframes telemetry-sweep {
805:   0% {
806:     left: -60%;
807:   }
808:   50%, 100% {
809:     left: 140%;
810:   }
811: }
812: 
813: .ghost-watermark-text {
814:   position: absolute;
815:   font-family: var(--font-mono);
816:   font-weight: 800;
817:   letter-spacing: -0.04em;
818:   line-height: 1;
819:   pointer-events: none;
820:   user-select: none;
821:   z-index: 0;
822:   text-transform: uppercase;
823:   color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025);
824: }
825: 
826: [data-theme="light"] .ghost-watermark-text {
827:   color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
828: }
829: 
830: .conduit-stream-line {
831:   position: relative;
832:   width: 1px;
833:   height: 60px;
834:   background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.45) 0%, rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.1) 80%, transparent 100%);
835:   margin: 0 auto;
836: }
837: 
838: .conduit-stream-line::after {
839:   content: '';
840:   position: absolute;
841:   top: 0;
842:   left: -2px;
843:   width: 5px;
844:   height: 5px;
845:   border-radius: 50%;
846:   background: #FF7300;
847:   box-shadow: 0 0 8px #FF7300;
848:   animation: conduit-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
849: }
850: 
851: @keyframes conduit-pulse {
852:   0% {
853:     top: 0;
854:     opacity: 0;
855:   }
856:   20% {
857:     opacity: 1;
858:   }
859:   80% {
860:     opacity: 1;
861:   }
862:   100% {
863:     top: 100%;
864:     opacity: 0;
865:   }
866: }
867: 
868: /* Pipeline Animated Flow Conduits */
869: .pipeline-track-connector {
870:   position: relative;
871:   height: 2px;
872:   background: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.15);
873:   overflow: hidden;
874: }
875: 
876: .pipeline-track-connector::after {
877:   content: '';
878:   position: absolute;
879:   top: 0;
880:   left: -40%;
881:   width: 40%;
882:   height: 100%;
883:   background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #FF7300, transparent);
884:   animation: pipeline-flow 3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
885: }
886: 
887: @keyframes pipeline-flow {
888:   0% {
889:     left: -40%;
890:   }
891:   100% {
892:     left: 140%;
893:   }
894: }

896: /* Nav Link Hover Underline */
897: .nav-link-btn {
898:   position: relative;
899:   background: none;
900:   border: none;
901:   cursor: pointer;
902:   padding: 4px 0;
903:   font-size: 0.85rem;
904:   font-weight: 500;

907: 
908: .nav-link-btn:hover {

911: 
912: .nav-link-btn::after {
913:   content: '';
914:   position: absolute;
915:   bottom: 0;
916:   left: 0;
917:   width: 100%;
918:   height: 2px;
919:   background: #FF7300;

## Assistant (Build · antigravity/claude-opus-4-6-thinking · 59.9s)



Based on my thorough reading of the entire backend codebase, here are the most impactful improvements for the SIF model and surrounding backend infrastructure, organized by priority:

---

## 1. SIF Classifier Architecture

**Current state** (`app/services/sif/classifier.py`): The classifier uses XGBoost on 11 one-hot-encoded categorical features, with a heuristic fallback and weak supervision rules. The model is loaded from disk or ModelRegistry.

**Problems:**
- **No text features used at inference time.** The classifier only uses structured categorical columns (`activity_type`, `hazard_category`, etc.). The actual report narrative -- the richest signal -- is ignored by the ML model. Embeddings are generated elsewhere but never fed into the classifier.
- **Heuristic fallback dominates.** When the model isn't loaded (common in dev/fresh deploys), `_heuristic_classify` runs keyword matching, which is brittle and un-tunable.
- **Weak rules applied post-hoc.** `WeakSupervisionRules` override the model score in `_apply_weak_supervision`, which can silently flip classifications without confidence calibration.
- **No calibration.** Raw XGBoost `predict_proba` outputs are not calibrated -- the 0.70/0.40 thresholds are arbitrary against uncalibrated scores.

**Recommendations:**

```
a) Fuse text embeddings into the classifier feature vector.
   - Concatenate the 384-dim BGE embedding with the one-hot structural
     features before training. This is a ~5-line change in train_sif_model.py
     and classifier.py but would dramatically improve recall.

b) Add Platt scaling or isotonic regression calibration.
   - sklearn.calibration.CalibratedClassifierCV on the validation set.
   - Makes the 0.70/0.40 thresholds meaningful as actual probabilities.

c) Replace the heuristic fallback with a lightweight model.
   - Train a small logistic regression on embeddings-only as the fallback,
     instead of keyword matching. Still cheap to run, far more accurate.

d) Integrate weak rules as features, not overrides.
   - Instead of _apply_weak_supervision mutating the score post-hoc,
     encode each weak rule trigger as a binary feature column and let
     the model learn their weights.
```

---

## 2. Training Pipeline

**Current state** (`scripts/train_sif_model.py`): Trains on CSV data with weak-supervision-generated labels, 80/20 stratified split, saves to `models/` and ModelRegistry.

**Problems:**
- **Labels come from weak supervision only.** `WeakSupervisionRules.label()` generates the training labels, meaning the model is learning to mimic heuristics, not ground truth.
- **No cross-validation.** Single 80/20 split gives no variance estimate.
- **No hyperparameter tuning.** XGBoost params are hardcoded.
- **No evaluation beyond accuracy.** For SIF (safety-critical, class-imbalanced), precision/recall/F1 on the SIF class matter far more than accuracy.

**Recommendations:**

```
a) Curate a human-labeled gold set.
   - Even 200-300 expert-labeled reports would anchor the model.
   - Use the ReviewQueue page (already built) to collect these.
   - Train on weak labels + gold labels with snorkel-style label model.

b) Add stratified k-fold cross-validation (k=5).
   - Report mean +/- std for precision, recall, F1-score on SIF class.

c) Add hyperparameter search.
   - Optuna or sklearn RandomizedSearchCV over max_depth, n_estimators,
     learning_rate, scale_pos_weight (critical for class imbalance).

d) Log class-specific metrics to MLflow.
   - classification_report, confusion matrix, PR curve, ROC-AUC.
   - The MLflow integration exists but only logs basic metrics.

e) Add scale_pos_weight to handle class imbalance.
   - XGBoost supports this natively. Calculate from label distribution.
```

---

## 3. Feature Engineering

**Current state** (`app/ml/features.py`): 11 categorical columns passed through `OneHotEncoder`.

**Problems:**
- Very sparse, low-information feature space. Many categories will have very few samples.
- No numeric features (severity scores, counts, temporal features).
- No text-derived features beyond embeddings.

**Recommendations:**

```
a) Add numeric features:
   - len(description), number of hazard keywords found, number of
     barriers mentioned, number of people involved, time-of-day,
     day-of-week (shift patterns correlate with SIF risk).

b) Add text-derived features:
   - TF-IDF top terms, named entity counts, negation presence,
     severity-word density (killed, fatal, crushed, etc.).

c) Add interaction features:
   - activity_type x hazard_category (e.g., "confined_space" +
     "toxic_gas" is a known SIF precursor combination).

d) Use target encoding instead of one-hot for high-cardinality
   categoricals (e.g., location, equipment_type) to avoid sparse
   explosion.
```

---

## 4. Embedding Service

**Current state** (`app/services/embeddings.py`): Singleton `sentence-transformers` model with in-memory `similarity_cache`.

**Problems:**
- **Unbounded cache.** `similarity_cache` dict grows without limit -- memory leak in production.
- **No persistence.** Embeddings are recomputed on every restart.
- **Blocking I/O.** Embedding generation is synchronous and blocks the FastAPI event loop.

**Recommendations:**

```
a) Add LRU eviction to the cache (functools.lru_cache or cachetools.LRUCache
   with a max size of ~10k entries).

b) Persist embeddings in the DB.
   - SafetyReport already has a text_hash field concept. Store the
     embedding vector alongside it. Avoid recomputation on restart.

c) Run embedding generation in a thread pool.
   - FastAPI's run_in_executor() for the encode() call, since
     sentence-transformers is CPU-bound and blocks the async loop.
```

---

## 5. LSR Matcher

**Current state** (`app/services/lsr/matcher.py`): Keyword matching + embedding cosine similarity, threshold 0.65.

**Problems:**
- Keywords are hardcoded per rule. If a report uses different terminology (e.g., "lockout" vs "LOTO"), it may miss.
- The embedding comparison uses generic sentence similarity, not fine-tuned for LSR domain.

**Recommendations:**

```
a) Expand keyword lists using domain synonym expansion.
   - Use the Terminology table (already exists in DB models but appears
     unused) to maintain a managed synonym map.

b) Add a learned re-ranker.
   - After keyword + embedding candidate retrieval, apply a small
     cross-encoder or logistic regression to re-rank matches.
   - Reduces false positives without hurting recall.

c) Return top-N matches with scores instead of threshold-only.
   - Let the ReviewQueue surface borderline matches for human review.
```

---

## 6. Model Lifecycle & Monitoring

**Current state**: ModelRegistry table exists but is only written to by the training script. No A/B testing, no drift detection, no automated retraining.

**Recommendations:**

```
a) Add prediction logging.
   - Log every (input_hash, prediction, confidence, model_version)
     to a predictions table. Essential for monitoring and retraining.

b) Add data drift detection.
   - Compare incoming feature distributions against training
     distributions. Alert when PSI or KL divergence exceeds threshold.

c) Add champion/challenger model serving.
   - ModelRegistry already has an is_active flag. Support loading two
     models and shadow-scoring with the challenger, comparing results
     before promotion.

d) Automate retraining trigger.
   - When N new human-reviewed labels accumulate (via ReviewQueue),
     trigger a retrain job via AnalysisJob.
```

---

## 7. Quick Wins (low effort, high impact)

```
a) The extraction service (app/services/extraction/service.py) uses
   hardcoded barrier taxonomies. Move these to a config file or DB
   table so domain experts can update without code changes.

b) The clustering service recomputes clusters from scratch every time.
   Add incremental cluster assignment for new reports using the
   existing cluster centroids.

c) Add input validation on the SIF classifier -- currently no check
   for missing/null feature values before prediction, which silently
   produces garbage scores.

d) The OCR preprocessing (grayscale + contrast) is minimal. Add
   deskewing and noise removal for scanned field reports, which are
   the primary input for OIL.
```

The highest-ROI change is **(1a)** -- fusing text embeddings into the classifier. The model currently ignores the report narrative, which is where most SIF signal lives. Want me to implement any of these?
